completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. verses.display_text: The Lord will give you bread of affliction and scant water; those misleading you will certainly no longer approach you, for your eyes will see those misleading you,

verses.text: and your ears will hear the words of those behind you who led you astray, saying, “This is the way; let us walk in it, whether right or left.”
verses.display_text: and your ears will hear the words of those behind you who led you astray, saying, “This is the way; let us walk in it, whether right or left.”

verses.text: You will remove the silver-covered and gold-covered idols, reduce them to fine pieces and winnow them like a menstruating woman’s fluid; like dung you will push them away.
verses.display_text: You will remove the silver-covered and gold-covered idols, reduce them to fine pieces and winnow them like a menstruating woman’s fluid; like dung you will push them away.

verses.text: Then there will be rain for your land’s seed; bread from your land’s produce will be plentiful and rich, and on that day your livestock will graze a fertile, spacious place,
verses.display_text: Then there will be rain for your land’s seed; bread from your land’s produce will be plentiful and rich, and on that day your livestock will graze a fertile, spacious place,

verses.text: your bulls and cattle working the earth will eat straw prepared with barley and winnowed.
verses.display_text: your bulls and cattle working the earth will eat straw prepared with barley and winnowed.

verses.text: On every high mountain and every lofty hill there will be flowing water on that day, when many perish and towers fall.
verses.display_text: On every high mountain and every lofty hill there will be flowing water on that day, when many perish and towers fall.

verses.text: The moon’s light will be like the sun’s light, and the sun’s light will be sevenfold on the day when the Lord heals His people’s fracture; He will heal the pain of your wound.
verses.display_text: The moon’s light will be like the sun’s light, and the sun’s light will be sevenfold on the day when the Lord heals His people’s fracture; He will heal the pain of your wound.

verses.text: Behold, the Lord’s name comes after a long time, wrath burning. His lips’ utterance comes with glory, an utterance full of anger, and the anger of His wrath will consume like fire.
verses.display_text: Behold, the Lord’s name comes after a long time, wrath burning. His lips’ utterance comes with glory, an utterance full of anger, and the anger of His wrath will consume like fire.

verses.text: His spirit will come like water sweeping through a ravine, reaching the neck, and will divide to trouble nations in futile wandering. Delusion will pursue them and seize them in their faces.
verses.display_text: His spirit will come like water sweeping through a ravine, reaching the neck, and will divide to trouble nations in futile wandering. Delusion will pursue them and seize them in their faces.

verses.text: Must you always rejoice and always enter My holy places like festival-keepers, like people rejoicing as they enter with a flute to the Lord’s mountain, to Israel’s God?
verses.display_text: Must you always rejoice and always enter My holy places like festival-keepers, like people rejoicing as they enter with a flute to the Lord’s mountain, to Israel’s God?

verses.text: God will make His voice’s glory heard and show His arm’s wrath with fury, anger and consuming flame. He will strike violently with lightning, like water and hail falling together violently.
verses.display_text: God will make His voice’s glory heard and show His arm’s wrath with fury, anger and consuming flame. He will strike violently with lightning, like water and hail falling together violently.

verses.text: For at the Lord’s voice the Assyrians will be defeated by the blow with which He strikes them.
verses.display_text: For at the Lord’s voice the Assyrians will be defeated by the blow with which He strikes them.

verses.text: It will be all around him, from where he hoped for help, on which he himself relied; they will turn and fight him with flutes and a lyre.
verses.display_text: It will be all around him, from where he hoped for help, on which he himself relied; they will turn and fight him with flutes and a lyre.

verses.text: For you will be called to account ahead of time. Has it also been prepared for you to rule a deep ravine, with wood laid out, fire and much wood? The Lord’s wrath is like a ravine burning with sulfur.
verses.display_text: For you will be called to account ahead of time. Has it also been prepared for you to rule a deep ravine, with wood laid out, fire and much wood? The Lord’s wrath is like a ravine burning with sulfur.

verses.text: Woe to those going down to Egypt for help, trusting in horses and chariots because there are many, and in horses, a very great multitude, but not trusting Israel’s Holy One or seeking God!
verses.display_text: Woe to those going down to Egypt for help, trusting in horses and chariots because there are many, and in horses, a very great multitude, but not trusting Israel’s Holy One or seeking God!

verses.text: He Himself, wise, brought evils upon them; His word will certainly not be set aside. He will rise against evil people’s houses and against their futile hope,
verses.display_text: He Himself, wise, brought evils upon them; His word will certainly not be set aside. He will rise against evil people’s houses and against their futile hope,

verses.text: an Egyptian human being and not God, horses’ flesh, with no help. The Lord will bring His hand against them; the helpers will grow weary, and all will perish together.
verses.display_text: an Egyptian human being and not God, horses’ flesh, with no help. The Lord will bring His hand against them; the helpers will grow weary, and all will perish together.

verses.text: For thus the Lord said to me: “As a lion or lion cub cries over prey it has caught and shouts over it until the mountains fill with its voice, and they are defeated and terrified by the greatness of its wrath, so the Lord Sabaoth will descend to march upon Mount Zion, upon her mountains.
verses.display_text: For thus the Lord said to me: “As a lion or lion cub cries over prey it has caught and shouts over it until the mountains fill with its voice, and they are defeated and terrified by the greatness of its wrath, so the Lord Sabaoth will descend to march upon Mount Zion, upon her mountains.

verses.text: Like flying birds, so the Lord will shield Jerusalem, rescue, preserve and save.”
verses.display_text: Like flying birds, so the Lord will shield Jerusalem, rescue, preserve and save.”

verses.text: Turn back, you planning a deep and lawless plan.
verses.display_text: Turn back, you planning a deep and lawless plan.

verses.text: For on that day people will renounce their silver and golden handmade things, which their hands made.
verses.display_text: For on that day people will renounce their silver and golden handmade things, which their hands made.

verses.text: Assour will fall. Neither a man’s sword nor a human’s sword will devour him, and he will flee, but not from a sword. The young men will be defeated,
verses.display_text: Assour will fall. Neither a man’s sword nor a human’s sword will devour him, and he will flee, but not from a sword. The young men will be defeated,

verses.text: for they will be enclosed by a rock as by a palisade and defeated, and the fugitive will be captured. Thus says the Lord: “Blessed is the one who has seed in Zion and household members in Jerusalem.”
verses.display_text: for they will be enclosed by a rock as by a palisade and defeated, and the fugitive will be captured. Thus says the Lord: “Blessed is the one who has seed in Zion and household members in Jerusalem.”

verses.text: For behold, a righteous king will reign, and rulers will rule with judgment.
verses.display_text: For behold, a righteous king will reign, and rulers will rule with judgment.

verses.text: The man will conceal his words and hide as from rushing water; he will appear in Zion like a rushing river, glorious in a thirsty land.
verses.display_text: The man will conceal his words and hide as from rushing water; he will appear in Zion like a rushing river, glorious in a thirsty land.

verses.text: They will no longer trust in human beings, but will give their ears to listen.
verses.display_text: They will no longer trust in human beings, but will give their ears to listen.

verses.text: The heart of the weak will pay attention and listen, and stammering tongues will quickly learn to speak peace.
verses.display_text: The heart of the weak will pay attention and listen, and stammering tongues will quickly learn to speak peace.

verses.text: They will no longer tell the fool to rule, and your attendants will no longer say, “Be silent.”
verses.display_text: They will no longer tell the fool to rule, and your attendants will no longer say, “Be silent.”

verses.text: For the fool will speak foolish things, and his heart will think futile things, carrying out lawless acts and speaking deception toward the Lord, scattering hungry souls and making thirsty souls empty.
verses.display_text: For the fool will speak foolish things, and his heart will think futile things, carrying out lawless acts and speaking deception toward the Lord, scattering hungry souls and making thirsty souls empty.

verses.text: For evil people’s counsel will devise lawless things, to destroy the lowly with unjust words and scatter the lowly people’s words in judgment.
verses.display_text: For evil people’s counsel will devise lawless things, to destroy the lowly with unjust words and scatter the lowly people’s words in judgment.

verses.text: The devout made wise plans, and this counsel will remain.
verses.display_text: The devout made wise plans, and this counsel will remain.

verses.text: Wealthy women, rise and hear my voice! Daughters in hope, hear my words!
verses.display_text: Wealthy women, rise and hear my voice! Daughters in hope, hear my words!

verses.text: Remember the days of a year in pain with hope; the vintage has been exhausted, the sowing has ceased and will certainly no longer come.
verses.display_text: Remember the days of a year in pain with hope; the vintage has been exhausted, the sowing has ceased and will certainly no longer come.

verses.text: Be dismayed, grieve, you confident women; undress, become naked and wrap sackcloth around your waists,
verses.display_text: Be dismayed, grieve, you confident women; undress, become naked and wrap sackcloth around your waists,

verses.text: and beat your breasts because of the desirable field and fruitful vine.
verses.display_text: and beat your breasts because of the desirable field and fruitful vine.

verses.text: My people’s earth will grow thorn and grass, and joy will be removed from every house. Wealthy city,
verses.display_text: My people’s earth will grow thorn and grass, and joy will be removed from every house. Wealthy city,

verses.text: houses abandoned! They will leave the city’s wealth and desirable houses; villages will become caves for ever, wild donkeys’ delight, pastures for shepherds,
verses.display_text: houses abandoned! They will leave the city’s wealth and desirable houses; villages will become caves for ever, wild donkeys’ delight, pastures for shepherds,

verses.text: until a spirit from on high comes upon you. Chermel will become wilderness, and Chermel will be reckoned as forest.
verses.display_text: until a spirit from on high comes upon you. Chermel will become wilderness, and Chermel will be reckoned as forest.

verses.text: Judgment will rest in the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in Carmel.
verses.display_text: Judgment will rest in the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in Carmel.

verses.text: The works of righteousness will be peace; righteousness will secure rest, and they will be confident for ever.
verses.display_text: The works of righteousness will be peace; righteousness will secure rest, and they will be confident for ever.

verses.text: His people will dwell in a city of peace and live confidently, and they will rest with wealth.
verses.display_text: His people will dwell in a city of peace and live confidently, and they will rest with wealth.

verses.text: If hail comes down, it will not come upon you. Those dwelling in the forests will be confident like those in the plain.
verses.display_text: If hail comes down, it will not come upon you. Those dwelling in the forests will be confident like those in the plain.

verses.text: Blessed are those sowing beside every water, where ox and donkey tread!
verses.display_text: Blessed are those sowing beside every water, where ox and donkey tread!

verses.text: Woe to those afflicting you—yet no one afflicts you—and the one rejecting you does not reject. The rejecters will be captured and handed over; like a moth upon a cloak, so they will be defeated.
verses.display_text: Woe to those afflicting you—yet no one afflicts you—and the one rejecting you does not reject. The rejecters will be captured and handed over; like a moth upon a cloak, so they will be defeated.

verses.text: Lord, have mercy on us, for we have trusted in Thee. The disobedient people’s seed came to destruction, but our salvation is in a time of affliction.
verses.display_text: Lord, have mercy on us, for we have trusted in Thee. The disobedient people’s seed came to destruction, but our salvation is in a time of affliction.

verses.text: At the sound of Thy terror, peoples were dismayed by fear of Thee, and nations scattered.
verses.display_text: At the sound of Thy terror, peoples were dismayed by fear of Thee, and nations scattered.

verses.text: Now your spoils, small and great, will be gathered; as someone gathers locusts, so they will mock you.
verses.display_text: Now your spoils, small and great, will be gathered; as someone gathers locusts, so they will mock you.

verses.text: Holy is God, who dwells on high; Zion has been filled with judgment and righteousness.
verses.display_text: Holy is God, who dwells on high; Zion has been filled with judgment and righteousness.

verses.text: They will be handed over under law; our salvation is among treasures. There are wisdom, knowledge and reverence toward the Lord; these are treasures of righteousness.
verses.display_text: They will be handed over under law; our salvation is among treasures. There are wisdom, knowledge and reverence toward the Lord; these are treasures of righteousness.

verses.text: Behold, in your terror they themselves will fear; those you feared will fear you. For messengers will be sent asking for peace, weeping bitterly, pleading for peace.
verses.display_text: Behold, in your terror they themselves will fear; those you feared will fear you. For messengers will be sent asking for peace, weeping bitterly, pleading for peace.

verses.text: For their roads will be deserted; fear of the nations has ceased, the covenant with these people is removed, and you will certainly not reckon them as human beings.
verses.display_text: For their roads will be deserted; fear of the nations has ceased, the covenant with these people is removed, and you will certainly not reckon them as human beings.

verses.text: The earth mourned; Lebanon was ashamed; Sharon became marshes. Galilee and Carmel will be clearly visible.
verses.display_text: The earth mourned; Lebanon was ashamed; Sharon became marshes. Galilee and Carmel will be clearly visible.

verses.text: “Now I will rise,” says the Lord. “Now I will be glorified; now I will be exalted.
verses.display_text: “Now I will rise,” says the Lord. “Now I will be glorified; now I will be exalted.

verses.text: Now you will see, now you will perceive; your spirit’s strength will be futile. Fire will consume you.
verses.display_text: Now you will see, now you will perceive; your spirit’s strength will be futile. Fire will consume you.

verses.text: Nations will be burned, like a thorn thrown in a field and burned.
verses.display_text: Nations will be burned, like a thorn thrown in a field and burned.

verses.text: Those far away will hear what I did; those drawing near will know My strength.”
verses.display_text: Those far away will hear what I did; those drawing near will know My strength.”

verses.text: The lawless in Zion departed; trembling will seize the ungodly. Who will announce to you that fire burns? Who will announce to you the everlasting place?
verses.display_text: The lawless in Zion departed; trembling will seize the ungodly. Who will announce to you that fire burns? Who will announce to you the everlasting place?

verses.text: One walking in righteousness, speaking a straight way, hating lawlessness and injustice, shaking his hands free of gifts, making his ears heavy so as not to hear a judgment of blood, and closing his eyes so as not to see injustice,
verses.display_text: One walking in righteousness, speaking a straight way, hating lawlessness and injustice, shaking his hands free of gifts, making his ears heavy so as not to hear a judgment of blood, and closing his eyes so as not to see injustice,

verses.text: this one will dwell in a high cave of strong rock. Bread will be given him, and his water is trustworthy.
verses.display_text: this one will dwell in a high cave of strong rock. Bread will be given him, and his water is trustworthy.

verses.text: You will see a king with glory, and your eyes will see a land from afar.
verses.display_text: You will see a king with glory, and your eyes will see a land from afar.

verses.text: Your soul will ponder fear: “Where are the scholars? Where are the counselors? Where is the one counting those being fed,
verses.display_text: Your soul will ponder fear: “Where are the scholars? Where are the counselors? Where is the one counting those being fed,

verses.text: a people small and great?” With whom they did not deliberate, nor did he know a deep voice, so that a despised people would not hear; the hearer has no understanding.
verses.display_text: a people small and great?” With whom they did not deliberate, nor did he know a deep voice, so that a despised people would not hear; the hearer has no understanding.

verses.text: Behold, Zion, the city, our salvation! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a wealthy city, tents that will certainly not be shaken; her tent’s pegs will never be moved, nor her ropes torn.
verses.display_text: Behold, Zion, the city, our salvation! Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a wealthy city, tents that will certainly not be shaken; her tent’s pegs will never be moved, nor her ropes torn.

verses.text: For the Lord’s name is great for you. There will be a place for you, rivers and broad, spacious canals. You will not go this way, nor will a rowing ship go.
verses.display_text: For the Lord’s name is great for you. There will be a place for you, rivers and broad, spacious canals. You will not go this way, nor will a rowing ship go.

verses.text: For my God is great; the Lord will not pass me by. The Lord is our judge, the Lord our ruler, the Lord our king; this One will save us.
verses.display_text: For my God is great; the Lord will not pass me by. The Lord is our judge, the Lord our ruler, the Lord our king; this One will save us.

verses.text: Your ropes tore because it was not strong; your mast tilted. It will not lower the sails or raise a signal until it is handed over for plunder. Then many lame people will take spoil.
verses.display_text: Your ropes tore because it was not strong; your mast tilted. It will not lower the sails or raise a signal until it is handed over for plunder. Then many lame people will take spoil.

verses.text: The people dwelling among them will certainly not say, “I am weary,” for their sin has been forgiven.
verses.display_text: The people dwelling among them will certainly not say, “I am weary,” for their sin has been forgiven.

verses.text: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!
verses.display_text: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!

verses.text: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.
verses.display_text: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.

verses.text: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.
verses.display_text: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.

verses.text: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.
verses.display_text: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.

verses.text: My sword became drunk in heaven. Behold, it will descend upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction, with judgment.
verses.display_text: My sword became drunk in heaven. Behold, it will descend upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction, with judgment.

verses.text: The Lord’s sword was filled with blood, thickened with lambs’ fat and the fat of male goats and rams, for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor and a great slaughter in Idumea.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s sword was filled with blood, thickened with lambs’ fat and the fat of male goats and rams, for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor and a great slaughter in Idumea.

verses.text: The stout ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls; the earth will become drunk with blood and be filled with their fat.
verses.display_text: The stout ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls; the earth will become drunk with blood and be filled with their fat.

verses.text: For it is the Lord’s day of judgment and a year of repayment for Zion’s judgment.
verses.display_text: For it is the Lord’s day of judgment and a year of repayment for Zion’s judgment.

verses.text: Her ravines will turn to pitch, her earth to sulfur, and her land will burn like pitch
verses.display_text: Her ravines will turn to pitch, her earth to sulfur, and her land will burn like pitch

verses.text: night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.
verses.display_text: night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.

verses.text: Birds, hedgehogs, ibises and ravens will dwell in her; a measuring cord for deserted land will be cast upon her, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in her.
verses.display_text: Birds, hedgehogs, ibises and ravens will dwell in her; a measuring cord for deserted land will be cast upon her, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in her.

verses.text: Her rulers will be no more, for her kings, her rulers and her magnates will come to destruction.
verses.display_text: Her rulers will be no more, for her kings, her rulers and her magnates will come to destruction.

verses.text: Thorny trees will sprout in their cities and her fortifications; she will become a dwelling for sirens and a courtyard for ostriches.
verses.display_text: Thorny trees will sprout in their cities and her fortifications; she will become a dwelling for sirens and a courtyard for ostriches.

verses.text: Demons will meet donkey-centaurs and cry one to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.
verses.display_text: Demons will meet donkey-centaurs and cry one to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.

verses.text: There a hedgehog nested, and the earth kept her children safe. There deer met and saw one another’s faces;
verses.display_text: There a hedgehog nested, and the earth kept her children safe. There deer met and saw one another’s faces;

verses.text: they passed by in number, and not one of them perished; none sought another, for the Lord commanded them and His spirit gathered them.
verses.display_text: they passed by in number, and not one of them perished; none sought another, for the Lord commanded them and His spirit gathered them.

verses.text: He Himself will cast lots for them, and His hand apportioned grazing. You will inherit for an everlasting time; for generations of generations they will rest upon her.
verses.display_text: He Himself will cast lots for them, and His hand apportioned grazing. You will inherit for an everlasting time; for generations of generations they will rest upon her.

verses.text: Rejoice, thirsty wilderness! Let the wilderness exult and flower like a lily,
verses.display_text: Rejoice, thirsty wilderness! Let the wilderness exult and flower like a lily,

verses.text: and the Jordan’s desert places will flower and exult. Lebanon’s glory and Carmel’s honor were given to her, and My people will see the Lord’s glory and God’s height.
verses.display_text: and the Jordan’s desert places will flower and exult. Lebanon’s glory and Carmel’s honor were given to her, and My people will see the Lord’s glory and God’s height.

verses.text: Be strong, limp hands and paralyzed knees!
verses.display_text: Be strong, limp hands and paralyzed knees!

verses.text: Give encouragement, you fainthearted in mind. Be strong; do not fear! Behold, our God repays judgment and will repay; He Himself will come and save us.
verses.display_text: Give encouragement, you fainthearted in mind. Be strong; do not fear! Behold, our God repays judgment and will repay; He Himself will come and save us.

verses.text: Then blind people’s eyes will open, and deaf people’s ears will hear.
verses.display_text: Then blind people’s eyes will open, and deaf people’s ears will hear.

verses.text: Then the lame person will leap like a deer, and the tongue of those with difficulty speaking will be clear, for water burst out in the wilderness and a ravine in a thirsty land,
verses.display_text: Then the lame person will leap like a deer, and the tongue of those with difficulty speaking will be clear, for water burst out in the wilderness and a ravine in a thirsty land,

verses.text: the waterless place will become marshes, and a water spring will be in the thirsty land. There will be birds’ gladness, a dwelling of reeds and marshes.
verses.display_text: the waterless place will become marshes, and a water spring will be in the thirsty land. There will be birds’ gladness, a dwelling of reeds and marshes.

verses.text: There will be a clean road, called a Holy Way. No unclean person will ever pass there, nor will there be an unclean way there; the scattered will walk upon it and will certainly not wander.
verses.display_text: There will be a clean road, called a Holy Way. No unclean person will ever pass there, nor will there be an unclean way there; the scattered will walk upon it and will certainly not wander.

verses.text: No lion will be there, nor will any evil wild beast ever go up on it or be found there; instead, the redeemed will walk in it.
verses.display_text: No lion will be there, nor will any evil wild beast ever go up on it or be found there; instead, the redeemed will walk in it.

verses.text: Those gathered through the Lord will return and come to Zion with gladness, everlasting gladness above their heads; for praise and exultation are upon their heads, and gladness will overtake them. Pain, grief and groaning have fled.
verses.display_text: Those gathered through the Lord will return and come to Zion with gladness, everlasting gladness above their heads; for praise and exultation are upon their heads, and gladness will overtake them. Pain, grief and groaning have fled.

verses.text: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of the Assyrians came up against Judea’s fortified cities and took them.
verses.display_text: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of the Assyrians came up against Judea’s fortified cities and took them.

verses.text: The king of the Assyrians sent Rapsakes from Lachis to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a large force. He stood at the upper pool’s aqueduct, on the road of the fuller’s field.
verses.display_text: The king of the Assyrians sent Rapsakes from Lachis to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a large force. He stood at the upper pool’s aqueduct, on the road of the fuller’s field.

verses.display_text: Eliakim son of Chelkias, the steward, Somnas the scribe, and Joach son of Asaph, the record-keeper, went out to him.

verses.text: Rapsakes said to them, “Tell Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians: ‘What do you trust in?
verses.display_text: Rapsakes said to them, “Tell Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians: ‘What do you trust in?

verses.text: Does a battle line arise through counsel or words of lips? Now whom have you trusted, that you disobey me?
verses.display_text: Does a battle line arise through counsel or words of lips? Now whom have you trusted, that you disobey me?

verses.text: Behold, you trust this broken reed staff, Egypt. Whoever leans on it, it will enter his hand. Such are Pharaoh king of Egypt and all who trust in him.
verses.display_text: Behold, you trust this broken reed staff, Egypt. Whoever leans on it, it will enter his hand. Such are Pharaoh king of Egypt and all who trust in him.

verses.text: But if you say, “We trust the Lord our God,”
verses.display_text: But if you say, “We trust the Lord our God,”

verses.text: now join with my master, the king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you can provide riders for them.
verses.display_text: now join with my master, the king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you can provide riders for them.

verses.text: How can you face even one district governor? Those trusting Egyptians for horses and riders are servants.
verses.display_text: How can you face even one district governor? Those trusting Egyptians for horses and riders are servants.

verses.text: Now have we come up without the Lord against this country to wage war upon it?’”
verses.display_text: Now have we come up without the Lord against this country to wage war upon it?’”

verses.text: Eliakim, Somnas and Joach said to him, “Speak Syrian to your servants, for we understand, and do not speak Judean to us. Why do you speak within hearing of the people on the wall?”
verses.display_text: Eliakim, Somnas and Joach said to him, “Speak Syrian to your servants, for we understand, and do not speak Judean to us. Why do you speak within hearing of the people on the wall?”

verses.text: Rapsakes said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master or to you to speak these words? Was it not to the people sitting on the wall, so that they eat dung and drink urine together with you?”
verses.display_text: Rapsakes said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master or to you to speak these words? Was it not to the people sitting on the wall, so that they eat dung and drink urine together with you?”

verses.text: Rapsakes stood and cried in a loud voice in Judean: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians:
verses.display_text: Rapsakes stood and cried in a loud voice in Judean: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians:

verses.text: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words, which will not be able to rescue you,
verses.display_text: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you with words, which will not be able to rescue you,

verses.text: and do not let Hezekiah tell you, “God will rescue you, and this city will certainly not be handed into the king of the Assyrians’ hand.”
verses.display_text: and do not let Hezekiah tell you, “God will rescue you, and this city will certainly not be handed into the king of the Assyrians’ hand.”

verses.text: Do not listen to Hezekiah. Thus says the king of the Assyrians: If you wish to be blessed, come out to me; each will eat from his vine and fig trees, and you will drink your cistern’s water,
verses.display_text: Do not listen to Hezekiah. Thus says the king of the Assyrians: If you wish to be blessed, come out to me; each will eat from his vine and fig trees, and you will drink your cistern’s water,

verses.text: until I come and take you to a land like your land, a land of grain, wine, bread and vineyards.
verses.display_text: until I come and take you to a land like your land, a land of grain, wine, bread and vineyards.

verses.text: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, saying, “Your God will rescue you.” Have the nations’ gods each rescued his own country from the king of the Assyrians’ hand?
verses.display_text: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, saying, “Your God will rescue you.” Have the nations’ gods each rescued his own country from the king of the Assyrians’ hand?

verses.text: Where is the god of Aimath and Arphath? Where is the god of Seppharim’s city? Were they able to rescue Samaria from my hand?
verses.display_text: Where is the god of Aimath and Arphath? Where is the god of Seppharim’s city? Were they able to rescue Samaria from my hand?

verses.text: Which of all these nations’ gods rescued his land from my hand, that God should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?’”
verses.display_text: Which of all these nations’ gods rescued his land from my hand, that God should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?’”

verses.text: They were silent, and no one answered him a word, because the king had ordered that no one answer.
verses.display_text: They were silent, and no one answered him a word, because the king had ordered that no one answer.

verses.text: Eliakim son of Chelkias, the steward, Somnas the army’s scribe, and Joach son of Asaph, the record-keeper, came to Hezekiah with torn tunics and reported Rapsakes’ words.
verses.display_text: Eliakim son of Chelkias, the steward, Somnas the army’s scribe, and Joach son of Asaph, the record-keeper, came to Hezekiah with torn tunics and reported Rapsakes’ words.

verses.text: When King Hezekiah heard, he tore his garments, wrapped himself in sackcloth, and went up to the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: When King Hezekiah heard, he tore his garments, wrapped himself in sackcloth, and went up to the Lord’s house.

verses.text: He sent Eliakim the steward, Somnas the scribe, and the elders of the priests, wrapped in sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amos.
verses.display_text: He sent Eliakim the steward, Somnas the scribe, and the elders of the priests, wrapped in sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amos.

verses.text: They said to him, “Thus says Hezekiah: Today is a day of distress, reproach, reproof, and wrath, for labor has come upon the woman giving birth, but she has no strength to give birth.
verses.display_text: They said to him, “Thus says Hezekiah: Today is a day of distress, reproach, reproof, and wrath, for labor has come upon the woman giving birth, but she has no strength to give birth.

verses.text: May the Lord your God hear Rapsakes’ words, which the king of the Assyrians sent to reproach the living God and to reproach words that the Lord your God has heard. You shall plead with the Lord your God for those who remain.”
verses.display_text: May the Lord your God hear Rapsakes’ words, which the king of the Assyrians sent to reproach the living God and to reproach words that the Lord your God has heard. You shall plead with the Lord your God for those who remain.”

verses.text: The king’s servants came to Isaiah,
verses.display_text: The king’s servants came to Isaiah,

verses.text: and Isaiah said to them, “You shall say this to your master: Thus says the Lord: Do not fear the words you heard, with which the king of the Assyrians’ envoys reproached Me.
verses.display_text: and Isaiah said to them, “You shall say this to your master: Thus says the Lord: Do not fear the words you heard, with which the king of the Assyrians’ envoys reproached Me.

verses.text: Behold, I will put a spirit into him. On hearing a report he will return to his country, and he will fall by the sword in his own land.”
verses.display_text: Behold, I will put a spirit into him. On hearing a report he will return to his country, and he will fall by the sword in his own land.”

verses.text: Rapsakes returned and found the king besieging Lomna. The king of the Assyrians heard that
verses.display_text: Rapsakes returned and found the king besieging Lomna. The king of the Assyrians heard that

verses.text: Tharaka king of the Ethiopians had come out to besiege him. On hearing this he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.display_text: Tharaka king of the Ethiopians had come out to besiege him. On hearing this he turned back and sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.text: “You shall say this to Hezekiah king of Judea: Do not let your God, on whom you rely, deceive you by saying, ‘Jerusalem will certainly not be handed into the king of the Assyrians’ hands.’
verses.display_text: “You shall say this to Hezekiah king of Judea: Do not let your God, on whom you rely, deceive you by saying, ‘Jerusalem will certainly not be handed into the king of the Assyrians’ hands.’

verses.text: Or have you not heard what the kings of the Assyrians did—how they destroyed the whole earth?
verses.display_text: Or have you not heard what the kings of the Assyrians did—how they destroyed the whole earth?

verses.text: Did the gods of the nations my fathers destroyed rescue them—Gozan, Charran, and Raphes, which are in the country of Themad?
verses.display_text: Did the gods of the nations my fathers destroyed rescue them—Gozan, Charran, and Raphes, which are in the country of Themad?

verses.text: Where are the kings of Aimath and Arphath, and of the city of Seppharim, Anag, and Ougaua?”
verses.display_text: Where are the kings of Aimath and Arphath, and of the city of Seppharim, Anag, and Ougaua?”

verses.text: Hezekiah took the document from the messengers and opened it before the Lord.
verses.display_text: Hezekiah took the document from the messengers and opened it before the Lord.

verses.text: Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.display_text: Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,

verses.text: “Lord Sabaoth, God of Israel, seated upon the cherubim, Thou alone art God of every kingdom of the inhabited world. Thou didst make heaven and earth.
verses.display_text: “Lord Sabaoth, God of Israel, seated upon the cherubim, Thou alone art God of every kingdom of the inhabited world. Thou didst make heaven and earth.

verses.text: Hear, Lord; look, Lord, and see the words that Sennacherib sent to reproach the living God.
verses.display_text: Hear, Lord; look, Lord, and see the words that Sennacherib sent to reproach the living God.

verses.text: For the kings of the Assyrians have truly laid waste the whole inhabited world and their country,
verses.display_text: For the kings of the Assyrians have truly laid waste the whole inhabited world and their country,

verses.text: and cast their idols into the fire. For they were not gods, but works of human hands, wood and stones, and they destroyed them.
verses.display_text: and cast their idols into the fire. For they were not gods, but works of human hands, wood and stones, and they destroyed them.

verses.text: But Thou, Lord our God, save us from their hand, so that every kingdom of the earth may know that Thou alone art God.”
verses.display_text: But Thou, Lord our God, save us from their hand, so that every kingdom of the earth may know that Thou alone art God.”

verses.text: Isaiah son of Amos was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, “Thus says the Lord, God of Israel: I heard what you prayed to Me about Sennacherib king of the Assyrians.
verses.display_text: Isaiah son of Amos was sent to Hezekiah and said to him, “Thus says the Lord, God of Israel: I heard what you prayed to Me about Sennacherib king of the Assyrians.

verses.text: This is the word God spoke concerning him: Virgin daughter Zion despised and sneered at you; daughter Jerusalem shook her head over you.
verses.display_text: This is the word God spoke concerning him: Virgin daughter Zion despised and sneered at you; daughter Jerusalem shook her head over you.

verses.text: Whom did you reproach and provoke? Against whom did you raise your voice? Yet you did not lift your eyes on high toward the Holy One of Israel.
verses.display_text: Whom did you reproach and provoke? Against whom did you raise your voice? Yet you did not lift your eyes on high toward the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: For through messengers you reproached the Lord. You said, ‘With my many chariots I climbed the mountain heights and the furthest reaches of Lebanon. I cut down its cedar’s height and the cypress’s beauty, and entered the height of a part of the woodland.
verses.display_text: For through messengers you reproached the Lord. You said, ‘With my many chariots I climbed the mountain heights and the furthest reaches of Lebanon. I cut down its cedar’s height and the cypress’s beauty, and entered the height of a part of the woodland.

verses.text: I laid a bridge and dried up waters and every gathering of water.’
verses.display_text: I laid a bridge and dried up waters and every gathering of water.’

verses.text: Did you not hear long ago about these things I did? From ancient days I arranged them; now I have shown them: to desolate nations in strongholds and those dwelling in fortified cities.
verses.display_text: Did you not hear long ago about these things I did? From ancient days I arranged them; now I have shown them: to desolate nations in strongholds and those dwelling in fortified cities.

verses.text: I let the hands go, and they withered and became like dry grass on roofs and like wild grass.
verses.display_text: I let the hands go, and they withered and became like dry grass on roofs and like wild grass.

verses.text: But now I know your rest, your going out and your coming in.
verses.display_text: But now I know your rest, your going out and your coming in.

verses.text: Your wrath with which you raged, and your bitterness, have risen to Me. I will put a muzzle in your nose and a bridle in your lips, and turn you back by the way you came.
verses.display_text: Your wrath with which you raged, and your bitterness, have risen to Me. I will put a muzzle in your nose and a bridle in your lips, and turn you back by the way you came.

verses.text: This is your sign: This year eat what you have sown, in the second year what remains, and in the third, after sowing, reap and plant vineyards; you will eat their fruit.
verses.display_text: This is your sign: This year eat what you have sown, in the second year what remains, and in the third, after sowing, reap and plant vineyards; you will eat their fruit.

verses.text: Those remaining in Judea will grow a root below and produce seed above.
verses.display_text: Those remaining in Judea will grow a root below and produce seed above.

verses.text: For those remaining will go out from Jerusalem, and those being saved from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord Sabaoth will do these things.
verses.display_text: For those remaining will go out from Jerusalem, and those being saved from Mount Zion. The zeal of the Lord Sabaoth will do these things.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord against the king of the Assyrians: He will certainly not enter this city or shoot a missile against it; he will certainly not bring a shield against it or surround it with a siegework.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord against the king of the Assyrians: He will certainly not enter this city or shoot a missile against it; he will certainly not bring a shield against it or surround it with a siegework.

verses.text: By the way he came he will return. Thus says the Lord.
verses.display_text: By the way he came he will return. Thus says the Lord.

verses.text: I will shield this city to save it, because of Me and because of David My servant.”
verses.display_text: I will shield this city to save it, because of Me and because of David My servant.”

verses.text: An angel of the Lord went out and killed one hundred eighty-five thousand from the Assyrians’ camp. On rising early in the morning, they found all the bodies dead.
verses.display_text: An angel of the Lord went out and killed one hundred eighty-five thousand from the Assyrians’ camp. On rising early in the morning, they found all the bodies dead.

verses.text: The king of the Assyrians turned back, went away, and lived in Nineveh.
verses.display_text: The king of the Assyrians turned back, went away, and lived in Nineveh.

verses.text: While he was worshiping his cult-image in the house of Nasarach, his sons Adramelech and Sarasar struck him with swords. They escaped safely to Armenia, and his son Asordan reigned in his place.
verses.display_text: While he was worshiping his cult-image in the house of Nasarach, his sons Adramelech and Sarasar struck him with swords. They escaped safely to Armenia, and his son Asordan reigned in his place.

verses.text: At that time Hezekiah became ill to the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amos came to him and said, “Thus says the Lord: Arrange your household’s affairs, for you are dying and will not live.”
verses.display_text: At that time Hezekiah became ill to the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amos came to him and said, “Thus says the Lord: Arrange your household’s affairs, for you are dying and will not live.”

verses.text: Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
verses.display_text: Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,

verses.text: saying, “Remember, Lord, how I walked before Thee with truth, in a true heart, and did what was pleasing before Thee.” Hezekiah wept greatly.
verses.display_text: saying, “Remember, Lord, how I walked before Thee with truth, in a true heart, and did what was pleasing before Thee.” Hezekiah wept greatly.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

verses.text: “Go and tell Hezekiah: Thus says the Lord, God of David your father: I heard the voice of your prayer and saw your tears. Behold, I am adding fifteen years to your time.
verses.display_text: “Go and tell Hezekiah: Thus says the Lord, God of David your father: I heard the voice of your prayer and saw your tears. Behold, I am adding fifteen years to your time.

verses.text: I will save you from the king of the Assyrians’ hand, and I will shield this city.
verses.display_text: I will save you from the king of the Assyrians’ hand, and I will shield this city.

verses.text: This is your sign from the Lord that God will do this thing:”
verses.display_text: This is your sign from the Lord that God will do this thing:”

verses.text: “As for the shadow of the steps the sun descended—the ten steps of your father’s house—I will turn the sun back ten steps.” The sun went up the ten steps which the shadow had descended.
verses.display_text: “As for the shadow of the steps the sun descended—the ten steps of your father’s house—I will turn the sun back ten steps.” The sun went up the ten steps which the shadow had descended.

verses.text: A prayer of Hezekiah king of Judea, when he became ill and rose from his illness:
verses.display_text: A prayer of Hezekiah king of Judea, when he became ill and rose from his illness:

verses.text: I said, “At the height of my days, at Hades’ gates, I will leave my remaining years behind.”
verses.display_text: I said, “At the height of my days, at Hades’ gates, I will leave my remaining years behind.”

verses.text: I said, “I will certainly no longer see God’s salvation upon the earth; I will certainly no longer see a person
verses.display_text: I said, “I will certainly no longer see God’s salvation upon the earth; I will certainly no longer see a person

verses.text: from my family. I left the rest of my life; it went out and departed from me like someone taking down a tent he had pitched. My spirit beside me became like a weaver’s web as she approached to cut it off. On that day I was handed over
verses.display_text: from my family. I left the rest of my life; it went out and departed from me like someone taking down a tent he had pitched. My spirit beside me became like a weaver’s web as she approached to cut it off. On that day I was handed over

verses.text: until morning, as to a lion; thus he crushed my bones, for from day to night I was handed over.
verses.display_text: until morning, as to a lion; thus he crushed my bones, for from day to night I was handed over.

verses.text: Like a swallow I will cry out, and like a dove I will murmur. For my eyes failed from looking toward heaven’s height, toward the Lord who rescued me
verses.display_text: Like a swallow I will cry out, and like a dove I will murmur. For my eyes failed from looking toward heaven’s height, toward the Lord who rescued me

verses.text: and took away my soul’s pain.
verses.display_text: and took away my soul’s pain.

verses.text: For, Lord, a report about it was brought to Thee, and Thou didst raise my breath; comforted, I lived.
verses.display_text: For, Lord, a report about it was brought to Thee, and Thou didst raise my breath; comforted, I lived.

verses.text: For Thou didst choose my soul so that it would not perish, and didst cast all my sins behind me.
verses.display_text: For Thou didst choose my soul so that it would not perish, and didst cast all my sins behind me.

verses.text: For those in Hades will not praise Thee, nor will the dead bless Thee, nor will those in Hades hope for Thy mercy.
verses.display_text: For those in Hades will not praise Thee, nor will the dead bless Thee, nor will those in Hades hope for Thy mercy.

verses.text: The living will bless Thee, as I do. For from today I will have children who will announce Thy righteousness,
verses.display_text: The living will bless Thee, as I do. For from today I will have children who will announce Thy righteousness,

verses.text: Lord of my salvation. I will not cease blessing Thee with a harp all the days of my life before God’s house.”
verses.display_text: Lord of my salvation. I will not cease blessing Thee with a harp all the days of my life before God’s house.”

verses.text: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Take a cake made of figs, crush it and apply it as a poultice, and you will be healthy.”
verses.display_text: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Take a cake made of figs, crush it and apply it as a poultice, and you will be healthy.”

verses.text: Hezekiah said, “This is the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord God.”
verses.display_text: Hezekiah said, “This is the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord God.”

verses.text: At that time Marodach son of Laadan, king of Babylonia, sent letters, envoys, and gifts to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been ill to the point of death and had recovered.
verses.display_text: At that time Marodach son of Laadan, king of Babylonia, sent letters, envoys, and gifts to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been ill to the point of death and had recovered.

verses.text: Hezekiah rejoiced greatly over them and showed them the store of nekhotha, liquid myrrh, incense, perfumed ointment, silver, gold, all the storerooms of the treasury’s equipment, and everything in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house that Hezekiah did not show.
verses.display_text: Hezekiah rejoiced greatly over them and showed them the store of nekhotha, liquid myrrh, incense, perfumed ointment, silver, gold, all the storerooms of the treasury’s equipment, and everything in his treasuries. There was nothing in his house that Hezekiah did not show.

verses.text: The prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and said, “What are these men saying, and from where have they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come to me from a distant land, from Babylon.”
verses.display_text: The prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and said, “What are these men saying, and from where have they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come to me from a distant land, from Babylon.”

verses.text: Isaiah said, “What did they see in your house?” Hezekiah said, “They saw everything in my house. There is nothing in my house they did not see, and also the things in my treasuries.”
verses.display_text: Isaiah said, “What did they see in your house?” Hezekiah said, “They saw everything in my house. There is nothing in my house they did not see, and also the things in my treasuries.”

verses.text: Isaiah said to him, “Hear the word of the Lord Sabaoth:
verses.display_text: Isaiah said to him, “Hear the word of the Lord Sabaoth:

verses.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will take everything in your house. What your fathers gathered until this day will reach Babylon, and they will certainly leave nothing behind. God also said
verses.display_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will take everything in your house. What your fathers gathered until this day will reach Babylon, and they will certainly leave nothing behind. God also said

verses.text: that they will also take some of your children whom you fathered and make them eunuchs in the house of the Babylonians’ king.”
verses.display_text: that they will also take some of your children whom you fathered and make them eunuchs in the house of the Babylonians’ king.”

verses.text: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The Lord’s word that He spoke is good. Let there indeed be peace and righteousness in my days.”
verses.display_text: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The Lord’s word that He spoke is good. Let there indeed be peace and righteousness in my days.”

verses.text: Comfort, comfort My people, says God.
verses.display_text: Comfort, comfort My people, says God.

verses.text: You priests, speak to the heart of Jerusalem; comfort her. For her humiliation is fulfilled, her sin is loosed; for from the hand of the Lord she has received double for her sins.
A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God.
Every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; all the crooked places will become straight, and the rough country will become plains.
verses.display_text:
Every valley will be filled,
and every mountain and hill will be brought low;
all the crooked places will become straight,
and the rough country will become plains.

verses.text: And the glory of the Lord will be seen, and all flesh will see the salvation of God; for the Lord has spoken.
A voice says, “Cry out!” And I said, “What shall I cry?” All flesh is grass, and all the glory of man is as the flower of grass.
verses.display_text:
A voice says, “Cry out!”
And I said, “What shall I cry?”
All flesh is grass,
and all the glory of man is as the flower of grass.

verses.text: The grass has withered, and the flower has fallen;
verses.display_text: The grass has withered, and the flower has fallen;

verses.text: but the word of our God remains for ever.
verses.display_text: but the word of our God remains for ever.

verses.text: Go up on a high mountain, you who bring good news to Zion; lift up your voice with strength, you who bring good news to Jerusalem. Lift up; do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.display_text:
Go up on a high mountain, you who bring good news to Zion;
lift up your voice with strength, you who bring good news to Jerusalem.
Lift up; do not fear.
Say to the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

verses.text: Behold, the Lord comes with might, and His arm with dominion; behold, His reward is with Him, and His work before Him.
verses.display_text:
Behold, the Lord comes with might, and His arm with dominion;
behold, His reward is with Him, and His work before Him.

verses.text: Like a shepherd, He will shepherd His flock; and with His arm He will gather lambs, and comfort those that are with young.
Who measured the water with His hand, heaven with a span, and all the earth with a handful? Who weighed mountains with a weight and wooded valleys with a balance?
verses.display_text: Who measured the water with His hand, heaven with a span, and all the earth with a handful? Who weighed mountains with a weight and wooded valleys with a balance?

verses.text: Who knew the Lord’s mind, and who became His counselor to instruct Him?
verses.display_text: Who knew the Lord’s mind, and who became His counselor to instruct Him?

verses.text: With whom did He take counsel, and who instructed Him? Who showed Him judgment, or who showed Him the way of understanding?
verses.display_text: With whom did He take counsel, and who instructed Him? Who showed Him judgment, or who showed Him the way of understanding?

verses.text: If all the nations were counted like a drop from a bucket and like a scale’s slight tipping, they will also be counted like spittle.
verses.display_text: If all the nations were counted like a drop from a bucket and like a scale’s slight tipping, they will also be counted like spittle.

verses.text: Lebanon is not sufficient for burning, nor all the four-footed animals sufficient for a whole burnt offering,
verses.display_text: Lebanon is not sufficient for burning, nor all the four-footed animals sufficient for a whole burnt offering,

verses.text: and all the nations are as nothing and were counted as nothing.
verses.display_text: and all the nations are as nothing and were counted as nothing.

verses.text: To whom did you liken the Lord, and to what likeness did you liken Him?
verses.display_text: To whom did you liken the Lord, and to what likeness did you liken Him?

verses.text: Did a craftsman make an image, or did a goldsmith melt gold and gild it, fashioning it as a likeness?
verses.display_text: Did a craftsman make an image, or did a goldsmith melt gold and gild it, fashioning it as a likeness?

verses.text: For a craftsman chooses wood that will not rot and skillfully seeks how to set up his image so that it will not shake.
verses.display_text: For a craftsman chooses wood that will not rot and skillfully seeks how to set up his image so that it will not shake.

verses.text: Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not announced to you from the beginning? Did you not know the earth’s foundations?
verses.display_text: Will you not know? Will you not hear? Was it not announced to you from the beginning? Did you not know the earth’s foundations?

verses.text: He holds the earth’s circuit, and its inhabitants are like locusts. He set heaven like a vault and stretched it out like a tent to dwell in.
verses.display_text: He holds the earth’s circuit, and its inhabitants are like locusts. He set heaven like a vault and stretched it out like a tent to dwell in.

verses.text: He gives rulers nothing to rule and made the earth as nothing.
verses.display_text: He gives rulers nothing to rule and made the earth as nothing.

verses.text: For they will certainly not sow or plant, nor will their root take hold in the earth. He blew on them, and they dried; a storm will carry them away like brushwood.
verses.display_text: For they will certainly not sow or plant, nor will their root take hold in the earth. He blew on them, and they dried; a storm will carry them away like brushwood.

verses.text: “Now then, to whom did you liken Me, and shall I be exalted?” said the Holy One.
verses.display_text: “Now then, to whom did you liken Me, and shall I be exalted?” said the Holy One.

verses.text: Lift your eyes on high and see: Who displayed all these? He brings out His array by number and will call all by name. From abundant glory and in strength’s might, nothing escaped you.
verses.display_text: Lift your eyes on high and see: Who displayed all these? He brings out His array by number and will call all by name. From abundant glory and in strength’s might, nothing escaped you.

verses.text: Do not say, Jacob—and why did you declare, Israel—“My way was hidden from God, and my God removed judgment and departed”?

verses.text: Rejoice, heavens, and let earth exult! Let mountains burst out in joy and hills in righteousness, for God had mercy on His people and comforted His people’s lowly ones.
verses.display_text: Rejoice, heavens, and let earth exult! Let mountains burst out in joy and hills in righteousness, for God had mercy on His people and comforted His people’s lowly ones.

verses.text: But Zion said, “The Lord has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
verses.display_text: But Zion said, “The Lord has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

verses.text: “Will a woman forget her child, failing to have mercy on the offspring of her belly? Even if a woman forgets these, I will not forget you,” said the Lord.
verses.display_text: “Will a woman forget her child, failing to have mercy on the offspring of her belly? Even if a woman forgets these, I will not forget you,” said the Lord.

verses.text: “Behold, on My hands I painted your walls, and you are before Me continually.
verses.display_text: “Behold, on My hands I painted your walls, and you are before Me continually.

verses.text: You will swiftly be rebuilt by those who pulled you down, and those who laid you waste will depart from you.
verses.display_text: You will swiftly be rebuilt by those who pulled you down, and those who laid you waste will depart from you.

verses.text: Lift your eyes around and see them all. Behold, they gathered and came to you. As I live, says the Lord, you will put them all on and wrap them around you like a bride’s adornment.
verses.display_text: Lift your eyes around and see them all. Behold, they gathered and came to you. As I live, says the Lord, you will put them all on and wrap them around you like a bride’s adornment.

verses.text: For your deserted, destroyed, and fallen places will now be cramped by inhabitants, and those swallowing you will be removed far from you.
verses.display_text: For your deserted, destroyed, and fallen places will now be cramped by inhabitants, and those swallowing you will be removed far from you.

verses.text: For your sons whom you lost will say within your hearing, ‘This place is too cramped for me. Make room for me, so I can settle.’
verses.display_text: For your sons whom you lost will say within your hearing, ‘This place is too cramped for me. Make room for me, so I can settle.’

verses.text: You will say in your heart, ‘Who bore these for me? I was childless and widowed. Who raised these for me? I was left alone; where were these of mine?’”
verses.display_text: You will say in your heart, ‘Who bore these for me? I was childless and widowed. Who raised these for me? I was left alone; where were these of mine?’”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “Behold, I lift My hand toward nations and will raise My signal toward islands. They will bring your sons in their bosom and carry your daughters on shoulders,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “Behold, I lift My hand toward nations and will raise My signal toward islands. They will bring your sons in their bosom and carry your daughters on shoulders,

verses.text: and kings will be your foster fathers and ruling women your nurses. They will bow to you upon the earth’s surface and lick the dust of your feet. You will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.
verses.display_text: and kings will be your foster fathers and ruling women your nurses. They will bow to you upon the earth’s surface and lick the dust of your feet. You will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.

verses.text: Will anyone take spoils from a giant? If someone takes captives unjustly, will he be saved?”
verses.display_text: Will anyone take spoils from a giant? If someone takes captives unjustly, will he be saved?”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “If someone captures a giant, he will take spoils; one taking from a strong man will be saved. I will judge your case, and I will rescue your sons.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “If someone captures a giant, he will take spoils; one taking from a strong man will be saved. I will judge your case, and I will rescue your sons.

verses.text: Those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, drink their own blood like new wine, and become drunk. All flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and upholds Jacob’s strength.”
verses.display_text: Those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, drink their own blood like new wine, and become drunk. All flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and upholds Jacob’s strength.”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “What is your mother’s divorce document with which I sent her away? Or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, you were sold because of your sins, and I sent your mother away because of your lawless acts.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “What is your mother’s divorce document with which I sent her away? Or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, you were sold because of your sins, and I sent your mother away because of your lawless acts.

verses.text: Why did I come when no person was there, call when no one obeyed? Is My hand not strong enough to rescue? Am I not able to deliver? Behold, by My threat I will make the sea desolate and turn rivers to deserts; their fish will dry up for lack of water and die in thirst.
verses.display_text: Why did I come when no person was there, call when no one obeyed? Is My hand not strong enough to rescue? Am I not able to deliver? Behold, by My threat I will make the sea desolate and turn rivers to deserts; their fish will dry up for lack of water and die in thirst.

verses.text: I will clothe heaven in darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.”
verses.display_text: I will clothe heaven in darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.”

verses.text: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,
verses.display_text: The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,

verses.text: and the Lord’s instruction opens my ears. I do not disobey or contradict.
verses.display_text: and the Lord’s instruction opens my ears. I do not disobey or contradict.

verses.text: I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to slaps. I did not turn my face away from the shame of spitting.
verses.display_text: I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to slaps. I did not turn my face away from the shame of spitting.

verses.text: The Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed. Instead, I set my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.
verses.display_text: The Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed. Instead, I set my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.

verses.text: For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.
verses.display_text: For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.

verses.text: Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.
verses.display_text: Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.

verses.text: Who among you fears the Lord? Let him listen to His servant’s voice. Those walking in darkness have no light; trust in the Lord’s name and lean upon God.
verses.display_text: Who among you fears the Lord? Let him listen to His servant’s voice. Those walking in darkness have no light; trust in the Lord’s name and lean upon God.

verses.text: Behold, all of you burn fire and strengthen a flame. Walk by your fire’s light and the flame you kindled. These things came to you because of Me; you will fall asleep in sorrow.
verses.display_text: Behold, all of you burn fire and strengthen a flame. Walk by your fire’s light and the flame you kindled. These things came to you because of Me; you will fall asleep in sorrow.

verses.text: “Listen to Me, you who pursue what is right and seek the Lord. Look at the solid rock you quarried and the hollow of the pit you dug.
verses.display_text: “Listen to Me, you who pursue what is right and seek the Lord. Look at the solid rock you quarried and the hollow of the pit you dug.

verses.text: Look at Abraham your father and Sarah who labored to bear you. He was one, and I called him, blessed him, loved him, and multiplied him.
verses.display_text: Look at Abraham your father and Sarah who labored to bear you. He was one, and I called him, blessed him, loved him, and multiplied him.

verses.text: I will now comfort you, Zion; I have comforted all her deserted places and will make her deserted places like the Lord’s paradise. They will find joy and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise.
verses.display_text: I will now comfort you, Zion; I have comforted all her deserted places and will make her deserted places like the Lord’s paradise. They will find joy and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise.

verses.text: Listen to Me, listen, My people; and kings, give ear to Me. For law will go out from Me, and My judgment as a light for nations.
verses.display_text: Listen to Me, listen, My people; and kings, give ear to Me. For law will go out from Me, and My judgment as a light for nations.

verses.text: My righteousness approaches swiftly, and My salvation will go out like light. Nations will hope in My arm; islands will wait for Me and hope in My arm.
verses.display_text: My righteousness approaches swiftly, and My salvation will go out like light. Nations will hope in My arm; islands will wait for Me and hope in My arm.

verses.text: Lift your eyes to heaven and look at earth below. Heaven was made firm like smoke, but earth will grow old like a garment, and earth’s inhabitants will die like these. My salvation will last for ever, and My righteousness will never fail.
verses.display_text: Lift your eyes to heaven and look at earth below. Heaven was made firm like smoke, but earth will grow old like a garment, and earth’s inhabitants will die like these. My salvation will last for ever, and My righteousness will never fail.

verses.text: Listen to Me, you who know judgment, My people with My law in your heart. Do not fear people’s reproach or be overcome by their contempt.
verses.display_text: Listen to Me, you who know judgment, My people with My law in your heart. Do not fear people’s reproach or be overcome by their contempt.

verses.text: For a garment will be consumed by time, and wool eaten by a moth. But My righteousness will last for ever, and My salvation through generations of generations.”
verses.display_text: For a garment will be consumed by time, and wool eaten by a moth. But My righteousness will last for ever, and My salvation through generations of generations.”

verses.text: Awake, awake, Jerusalem, and clothe yourself with the strength of your arm! Awake as at day’s beginning, as an age-old generation. Are you not the one
verses.display_text: Awake, awake, Jerusalem, and clothe yourself with the strength of your arm! Awake as at day’s beginning, as an age-old generation. Are you not the one

verses.text: who makes the sea desolate, the abundant water of the abyss, who made the sea depths a crossing road for those rescued
verses.display_text: who makes the sea desolate, the abundant water of the abyss, who made the sea depths a crossing road for those rescued

verses.text: and ransomed? For by the Lord they will be brought back and come to Zion with joy and everlasting exultation. Exultation and praise are upon their heads; joy will overtake them. Pain, sorrow, and sighing fled.
verses.display_text: and ransomed? For by the Lord they will be brought back and come to Zion with joy and everlasting exultation. Exultation and praise are upon their heads; joy will overtake them. Pain, sorrow, and sighing fled.

verses.text: “I am, I am the One comforting you. Recognize whom you dreaded and feared: a mortal person, a human being who withered like grass.
verses.display_text: “I am, I am the One comforting you. Recognize whom you dreaded and feared: a mortal person, a human being who withered like grass.

verses.text: You forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and feared continually, every day, the face of your oppressor’s anger. For as he planned to remove you—where now is your oppressor’s anger?
verses.display_text: You forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded earth, and feared continually, every day, the face of your oppressor’s anger. For as he planned to remove you—where now is your oppressor’s anger?

verses.text: For as you are saved, it will not stand or linger.
verses.display_text: For as you are saved, it will not stand or linger.

verses.text: For I am your God, who stirs the sea and makes its waves resound; the Lord Sabaoth is My name.
verses.display_text: For I am your God, who stirs the sea and makes its waves resound; the Lord Sabaoth is My name.

verses.text: I will put My words in your mouth and shelter you under My hand’s shadow, by which I established heaven and founded earth; and He will say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’
verses.display_text: I will put My words in your mouth and shelter you under My hand’s shadow, by which I established heaven and founded earth; and He will say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’

verses.text: Awake, awake, rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of anger from the Lord’s hand. You drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of anger.
verses.display_text: Awake, awake, rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of anger from the Lord’s hand. You drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of anger.

verses.text: There was no one to comfort you among all your children you bore, and no one to take your hand among all your sons you raised.
verses.display_text: There was no one to comfort you among all your children you bore, and no one to take your hand among all your sons you raised.

verses.text: These two confront you—who will grieve with you?—fall and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?
verses.display_text: These two confront you—who will grieve with you?—fall and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?

verses.text: Your sons are helpless, sleeping at every way out like a half-boiled beet, full of the Lord’s anger, exhausted because of the Lord God.
verses.display_text: Your sons are helpless, sleeping at every way out like a half-boiled beet, full of the Lord’s anger, exhausted because of the Lord God.

verses.text: Therefore listen, humbled one, drunk but not from wine.
verses.display_text: Therefore listen, humbled one, drunk but not from wine.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord God who judges His people: ‘Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of anger. You will not drink it again.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord God who judges His people: ‘Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of anger. You will not drink it again.

verses.text: I will throw it into the hands of those who wronged and humbled you, who told your soul, “Bend down, so we may pass.” You laid your back level with the earth, outside for passersby.’”
verses.display_text: I will throw it into the hands of those who wronged and humbled you, who told your soul, “Bend down, so we may pass.” You laid your back level with the earth, outside for passersby.’”

verses.text: Awake, awake, Zion! Clothe yourself with your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, holy city. No uncircumcised and unclean person will pass through you again.
verses.display_text: Awake, awake, Zion! Clothe yourself with your strength, Zion, and put on your glory, Jerusalem, holy city. No uncircumcised and unclean person will pass through you again.

verses.text: Shake off the dust and rise; sit, Jerusalem. Strip off the bond around your neck, captive daughter Zion.
verses.display_text: Shake off the dust and rise; sit, Jerusalem. Strip off the bond around your neck, captive daughter Zion.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: “You were sold for nothing, and without silver you will be ransomed.”
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: “You were sold for nothing, and without silver you will be ransomed.”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “My people formerly went down to Egypt to live there as strangers, and they were forcibly led to the Assyrians.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “My people formerly went down to Egypt to live there as strangers, and they were forcibly led to the Assyrians.

verses.text: And now, why are you here?” Thus says the Lord. “My people were taken for nothing. Be amazed and wail!” Thus says the Lord. “Because of you, My name is continually blasphemed among the nations.
verses.display_text: And now, why are you here?” Thus says the Lord. “My people were taken for nothing. Be amazed and wail!” Thus says the Lord. “Because of you, My name is continually blasphemed among the nations.

verses.text: Therefore My people will know My name on that day, because I am the One speaking. I am present
verses.display_text: Therefore My people will know My name on that day, because I am the One speaking. I am present

verses.text: like beauty on the mountains, like the feet of one proclaiming a report of peace, like one bringing good news. For I will make your salvation heard, saying, ‘Zion, your God will reign.’”
verses.display_text: like beauty on the mountains, like the feet of one proclaiming a report of peace, like one bringing good news. For I will make your salvation heard, saying, ‘Zion, your God will reign.’”

verses.text: For the voice of those guarding you was raised, and together they will rejoice with their voice. For eyes will see eye to eye when the Lord has mercy on Zion.
verses.display_text: For the voice of those guarding you was raised, and together they will rejoice with their voice. For eyes will see eye to eye when the Lord has mercy on Zion.

verses.text: Let Jerusalem’s deserted places break out in joy together, for the Lord had mercy on her and rescued Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: Let Jerusalem’s deserted places break out in joy together, for the Lord had mercy on her and rescued Jerusalem.

verses.text: The Lord will uncover His holy arm before all nations, and all the ends of earth will see the salvation that comes from God.
verses.display_text: The Lord will uncover His holy arm before all nations, and all the ends of earth will see the salvation that comes from God.

verses.text: Depart, depart; go out from there, and do not touch anything unclean. Go out from her midst; separate yourselves, you who carry the Lord’s vessels.
verses.display_text: Depart, depart; go out from there, and do not touch anything unclean. Go out from her midst; separate yourselves, you who carry the Lord’s vessels.
