verses.text: For you will not go out in turmoil or travel in flight, because the Lord will go ahead of you, and the One gathering you is the Lord, Israel’s God.
verses.display_text: For you will not go out in turmoil or travel in flight, because the Lord will go ahead of you, and the One gathering you is the Lord, Israel’s God.

verses.text: Behold, My servant will understand, and will be exalted and greatly glorified.
verses.display_text:
Behold, My servant will understand,
and will be exalted and greatly glorified.

verses.text: As many will be astonished at you— so your form will be without honour among men, and your glory among men—
verses.display_text:
As many will be astonished at you—
so your form will be without honour among men,
and your glory among men—

verses.text: so many nations will marvel at him, and kings will close their mouths. For those to whom he was not proclaimed will see, and those who have not heard will understand.
verses.display_text:
so many nations will marvel at him,
and kings will close their mouths.
For those to whom he was not proclaimed will see,
and those who have not heard will understand.

verses.text: O Lord, who has believed our report? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.display_text:
O Lord, who has believed our report?
And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

verses.text: We proclaimed before him as a child, as a root in thirsty ground. He has no form nor glory; and we saw him, and he had no form nor beauty.
verses.display_text:
We proclaimed before him as a child,
as a root in thirsty ground.
He has no form nor glory;
and we saw him, and he had no form nor beauty.

verses.text: But his form was without honour, fallen below all men: a man under affliction, and knowing how to bear sickness. For his face has been turned away; he was dishonoured and held of no account.
verses.display_text:
But his form was without honour, fallen below all men:
a man under affliction, and knowing how to bear sickness.
For his face has been turned away;
he was dishonoured and held of no account.

verses.text: He bears our sins, and suffers pain for us; yet we reckoned him to be in toil and affliction and distress.
verses.display_text:
He bears our sins, and suffers pain for us;
yet we reckoned him to be in toil and affliction and distress.

verses.text: But he was wounded for our iniquities, and has been weakened for our sins. The chastisement of our peace was upon him; by his bruise we were healed.
verses.display_text:
But he was wounded for our iniquities,
and has been weakened for our sins.
The chastisement of our peace was upon him;
by his bruise we were healed.

verses.text: We all, like sheep, have gone astray; each person has strayed in his own way. And the Lord delivered him over to our sins.
And because he has been afflicted, he does not open his mouth. Like a sheep he was led to slaughter, and as a lamb is silent before its shearer, so he does not open his mouth.
verses.display_text:
And because he has been afflicted, he does not open his mouth.
Like a sheep he was led to slaughter,
and as a lamb is silent before its shearer,
so he does not open his mouth.

verses.text: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away. Who will declare his generation? For his life is taken from the earth; because of the iniquities of My people he was led to death.
verses.display_text:
In his humiliation his judgment was taken away.
Who will declare his generation?
For his life is taken from the earth;
because of the iniquities of My people he was led to death.

verses.text: And I will give the wicked in exchange for his burial, and the rich in exchange for his death; for he committed no iniquity, nor was deceit found in his mouth.
And the Lord desires to cleanse him of his affliction. If you give an offering for sin, your soul will see seed that lives long. And the Lord desires to take him away
verses.display_text:
And the Lord desires to cleanse him of his affliction.
If you give an offering for sin,
your soul will see seed that lives long.
And the Lord desires to take him away

verses.text: from the toil of his soul, to show him light and fashion him with understanding, to justify the righteous one who serves many well; and he will bear their sins.

Therefore he will inherit many, and will divide the spoils of the mighty; for his soul was delivered to death, and he was numbered among the lawless. And he bore the sins of many, and for their sins he was delivered up.

“Rejoice, barren woman who does not give birth! Break out and cry aloud, you who do not labor in childbirth, because the deserted woman’s children are more numerous than those of the woman who has a husband,” for the Lord has spoken.
verses.display_text: “Rejoice, barren woman who does not give birth! Break out and cry aloud, you who do not labor in childbirth, because the deserted woman’s children are more numerous than those of the woman who has a husband,” for the Lord has spoken.

verses.text: “Widen the place of your tent and your curtains. Pitch them; do not spare! Lengthen your ropes and strengthen your pegs.
verses.display_text: “Widen the place of your tent and your curtains. Pitch them; do not spare! Lengthen your ropes and strengthen your pegs.

verses.text: Spread out still farther to right and left. Your offspring will inherit nations, and you will settle deserted cities.
verses.display_text: Spread out still farther to right and left. Your offspring will inherit nations, and you will settle deserted cities.

verses.text: Do not fear because you were put to shame, or be abashed because you were reproached. For you will forget lasting shame and never remember the reproach of your widowhood.
verses.display_text: Do not fear because you were put to shame, or be abashed because you were reproached. For you will forget lasting shame and never remember the reproach of your widowhood.

verses.text: For the Lord is the One making you; the Lord Sabaoth is His name. The One who rescued you is Himself Israel’s God; He will be called upon throughout all earth.
verses.display_text: For the Lord is the One making you; the Lord Sabaoth is His name. The One who rescued you is Himself Israel’s God; He will be called upon throughout all earth.

verses.text: “The Lord has not called you like an abandoned, fainthearted wife, nor like a wife hated since youth,” says your God.
verses.display_text: “The Lord has not called you like an abandoned, fainthearted wife, nor like a wife hated since youth,” says your God.

verses.text: “For a short time I abandoned you, and with great mercy I will have mercy on you.
verses.display_text: “For a short time I abandoned you, and with great mercy I will have mercy on you.

verses.text: In a little anger I turned My face from you, and with everlasting mercy I will have mercy on you,” says the Lord who rescued you.
verses.display_text: In a little anger I turned My face from you, and with everlasting mercy I will have mercy on you,” says the Lord who rescued you.

verses.text: “This dates for Me from the water in Noah’s time, when I swore to him then concerning the earth not to be angry with you again, nor at a threat against you
verses.display_text: “This dates for Me from the water in Noah’s time, when I swore to him then concerning the earth not to be angry with you again, nor at a threat against you

verses.text: for mountains to move away; nor will your hills be shifted. So neither will My mercy toward you fail, nor will your covenant of peace ever be removed.” For the Lord said, “I am gracious to you.”
verses.display_text: for mountains to move away; nor will your hills be shifted. So neither will My mercy toward you fail, nor will your covenant of peace ever be removed.” For the Lord said, “I am gracious to you.”

verses.text: Humbled and unsettled woman, you were not comforted! Behold, I am preparing carbuncle as your stone and sapphire as your foundations,
verses.display_text: Humbled and unsettled woman, you were not comforted! Behold, I am preparing carbuncle as your stone and sapphire as your foundations,

verses.text: and I will make your battlements jasper, your gates crystal stones, and your enclosing wall choice stones,
verses.display_text: and I will make your battlements jasper, your gates crystal stones, and your enclosing wall choice stones,

verses.text: and all your sons taught by God, and your children in great peace.
verses.display_text: and all your sons taught by God, and your children in great peace.

verses.text: You will be built in righteousness. Keep away from injustice, and you will not fear; terror will not approach you.
verses.display_text: You will be built in righteousness. Keep away from injustice, and you will not fear; terror will not approach you.

verses.text: Behold, newcomers will approach you through Me and take refuge with you.
verses.display_text: Behold, newcomers will approach you through Me and take refuge with you.

verses.text: Behold, I am creating you, not like a smith blowing coals and bringing out an implement for work. I did not create you for ruin, to destroy
verses.display_text: Behold, I am creating you, not like a smith blowing coals and bringing out an implement for work. I did not create you for ruin, to destroy

verses.text: every perishable implement. I will not grant success against you. Every voice will rise against you in judgment; you will defeat them all, and those accountable to you will be held liable in it. There is an inheritance for those serving the Lord, and you will be righteous before Me,” says the Lord.
verses.display_text: every perishable implement. I will not grant success against you. Every voice will rise against you in judgment; you will defeat them all, and those accountable to you will be held liable in it. There is an inheritance for those serving the Lord, and you will be righteous before Me,” says the Lord.

verses.text: You who thirst, go to the water; and you who have no silver, go and buy wine and rich food, and drink without silver or price.
Why do you pay a price of silver, and give your toil for what does not satisfy? Listen to Me, and you will eat good things, and your soul will delight in good things.
verses.display_text:
Why do you pay a price of silver,
and give your toil for what does not satisfy?
Listen to Me, and you will eat good things,
and your soul will delight in good things.

verses.text: Listen with your ears, and follow My ways; listen to Me, and your soul will live amid good things. And I will make with you an everlasting covenant: the holy and sure blessings of David.
verses.display_text:
Listen with your ears, and follow My ways;
listen to Me, and your soul will live amid good things.
And I will make with you an everlasting covenant:
the holy and sure blessings of David.

verses.text: Behold, I have given him as a testimony among the nations, a ruler and commander of nations.
verses.display_text:
Behold, I have given him as a testimony among the nations,
a ruler and commander of nations.

verses.text: Nations that did not know you will call upon you, and peoples that do not know you will flee to you for refuge, because of your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
verses.display_text:
Nations that did not know you will call upon you,
and peoples that do not know you will flee to you for refuge,
because of your God, the Holy One of Israel,
for He has glorified you.

verses.text: Seek God, and when you find Him, call upon Him; and when He draws near to you,
verses.display_text:
Seek God, and when you find Him, call upon Him;
and when He draws near to you,

verses.text: let the ungodly forsake his ways, and the lawless man his counsels; and let him return to the Lord, and he will receive mercy; for He will abundantly forgive your sins.
For My counsels are not as your counsels, nor are My ways like your ways, says the Lord.
verses.display_text:
For My counsels are not as your counsels,
nor are My ways like your ways, says the Lord.

verses.text: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is My way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from My mind.
verses.display_text:
But as the heaven is distant from the earth,
so is My way distant from your ways,
and your thoughts from My mind.

verses.text: For as rain or snow comes down from the heaven, and does not return until it has drenched the earth, and made it bring forth and sprout, and given seed to the sower and bread for food,
verses.display_text:
For as rain or snow comes down from the heaven,
and does not return until it has drenched the earth,
and made it bring forth and sprout,
and given seed to the sower and bread for food,

verses.text: so it will be with My word, whatever goes out from My mouth: it will certainly not return until all that I have willed is accomplished; and I will prosper your ways and My commandments.
For you will go out in gladness, and in joy you will be taught; for the mountains and the hills will leap, welcoming you with joy, and all the trees of the field will clap their branches.
And the cypress will rise in place of the thorny shrub, and the myrtle will rise in place of the fleabane; and the Lord will be for a name and for an everlasting sign, and will not fail.
verses.display_text:
And the cypress will rise in place of the thorny shrub,
and the myrtle will rise in place of the fleabane;
and the Lord will be for a name and for an everlasting sign,
and will not fail.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “Keep justice; do righteousness. For the coming of My salvation has drawn near, and the revealing of My mercy.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “Keep justice; do righteousness. For the coming of My salvation has drawn near, and the revealing of My mercy.

verses.text: Happy is the man who does these things, the person holding fast to them, keeping the Sabbaths from profanation and guarding his hands from wrongdoing.”
verses.display_text: Happy is the man who does these things, the person holding fast to them, keeping the Sabbaths from profanation and guarding his hands from wrongdoing.”

verses.text: Let no foreigner attached to the Lord say, “Will the Lord then separate me from His people?” And let no eunuch say, “I am a dry tree.”
verses.display_text: Let no foreigner attached to the Lord say, “Will the Lord then separate me from His people?” And let no eunuch say, “I am a dry tree.”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, choose what I wish, and hold fast to My covenant,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, choose what I wish, and hold fast to My covenant,

verses.text: I will give them in My house and wall a renowned place better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, and it will not fail.
verses.display_text: I will give them in My house and wall a renowned place better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, and it will not fail.

verses.text: And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—
verses.display_text: And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—

verses.text: I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
verses.display_text: I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”

verses.text: said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
verses.display_text: said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”

verses.text: All you wild beasts, come and eat, all you beasts of the woodland!
verses.display_text: All you wild beasts, come and eat, all you beasts of the woodland!

verses.text: See: all have been blinded; they did not know how to think. They are all mute dogs, unable to bark, dreaming of a bed, loving to doze.
verses.display_text: See: all have been blinded; they did not know how to think. They are all mute dogs, unable to bark, dreaming of a bed, loving to doze.

verses.text: The dogs are shameless in appetite, knowing no satisfaction, and they are evil, without understanding. They all followed their own ways, each according to what was his own.
verses.display_text: The dogs are shameless in appetite, knowing no satisfaction, and they are evil, without understanding. They all followed their own ways, each according to what was his own.

verses.text: See how the righteous man perished, and no one considers it in his heart. Righteous men are removed, and no one understands. For the righteous man was taken from the presence of injustice.
verses.display_text: See how the righteous man perished, and no one considers it in his heart. Righteous men are removed, and no one understands. For the righteous man was taken from the presence of injustice.

verses.text: His burial will be in peace; he has been removed from the midst.
verses.display_text: His burial will be in peace; he has been removed from the midst.

verses.text: “But you, come forward here, lawless sons, offspring of adulterers and a prostitute!
verses.display_text: “But you, come forward here, lawless sons, offspring of adulterers and a prostitute!

verses.text: In whom did you delight? Against whom did you open your mouth and let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless offspring?
verses.display_text: In whom did you delight? Against whom did you open your mouth and let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless offspring?

verses.text: You who appeal to idols beneath leafy trees, slaughtering their children in ravines among the rocks!
verses.display_text: You who appeal to idols beneath leafy trees, slaughtering their children in ravines among the rocks!

verses.text: That is your portion; this is your lot. To those you poured libations, and to those you brought sacrifices. Will I not therefore be angry over these things?
verses.display_text: That is your portion; this is your lot. To those you poured libations, and to those you brought sacrifices. Will I not therefore be angry over these things?

verses.text: On a high and lofty mountain—there is your bed, and there you brought sacrifices up.
verses.display_text: On a high and lofty mountain—there is your bed, and there you brought sacrifices up.

verses.text: Behind your doorposts you set your memorials. You thought that if you departed from Me you would have something more. You loved those sleeping with you
verses.display_text: Behind your doorposts you set your memorials. You thought that if you departed from Me you would have something more. You loved those sleeping with you

verses.text: and multiplied your prostitution with them. You increased the number of those far away from you, sent ambassadors beyond your boundaries, turned away, and were humbled as far as Hades.
verses.display_text: and multiplied your prostitution with them. You increased the number of those far away from you, sent ambassadors beyond your boundaries, turned away, and were humbled as far as Hades.

verses.text: You wore yourself out with your many journeys and did not say, ‘I will stop.’ You kept strengthening yourself because you did these things; therefore you did not implore Me—
verses.display_text: You wore yourself out with your many journeys and did not say, ‘I will stop.’ You kept strengthening yourself because you did these things; therefore you did not implore Me—

verses.text: you! Whom did you reverently fear, that you lied to Me, did not remember Me, and took Me neither into thought nor into your heart? I see you and overlook you, yet you did not fear Me.
verses.display_text: you! Whom did you reverently fear, that you lied to Me, did not remember Me, and took Me neither into thought nor into your heart? I see you and overlook you, yet you did not fear Me.

verses.text: I will proclaim My righteousness and your evils, which will not benefit you.
verses.display_text: I will proclaim My righteousness and your evils, which will not benefit you.

verses.text: When you cry aloud, let them rescue you in your distress! Wind will take all these, and a storm carry them away. But those holding fast to Me will acquire land and inherit My holy mountain.
verses.display_text: When you cry aloud, let them rescue you in your distress! Wind will take all these, and a storm carry them away. But those holding fast to Me will acquire land and inherit My holy mountain.

verses.text: They will say, ‘Clear roads before him, and remove obstacles from My people’s road.’
verses.display_text: They will say, ‘Clear roads before him, and remove obstacles from My people’s road.’

verses.text: Thus says the Lord Most High, who dwells in the heights for ever, whose name is Holy among holy ones, the Lord Most High resting among holy ones and giving patience to the fainthearted and life to the brokenhearted:
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord Most High, who dwells in the heights for ever, whose name is Holy among holy ones, the Lord Most High resting among holy ones and giving patience to the fainthearted and life to the brokenhearted:

verses.text: ‘I will not take vengeance on you for ever or always be angry with you. For spirit will go out from Me, and I made every breath.
verses.display_text: ‘I will not take vengeance on you for ever or always be angry with you. For spirit will go out from Me, and I made every breath.

verses.text: Because of sin I grieved him a little, struck him, and turned My face away from him. He was grieved and went gloomily along his ways.
verses.display_text: Because of sin I grieved him a little, struck him, and turned My face away from him. He was grieved and went gloomily along his ways.

verses.text: I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—
verses.display_text: I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—

verses.text: peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’
verses.display_text: peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’

verses.text: But the unjust will be tossed by waves in this way and will be unable to rest.
verses.display_text: But the unjust will be tossed by waves in this way and will be unable to rest.

verses.text: ‘There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,’ said the Lord God.”
verses.display_text: ‘There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,’ said the Lord God.”

verses.text: “Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.
verses.display_text: “Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.

verses.text: Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,
verses.display_text: Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,

verses.text: saying, ‘Why did we fast, and Thou didst not see? We humbled our lives, and Thou didst not notice?’ For on your fasting days you pursue your wishes and prod all those under your control.
verses.display_text: saying, ‘Why did we fast, and Thou didst not see? We humbled our lives, and Thou didst not notice?’ For on your fasting days you pursue your wishes and prod all those under your control.

verses.text: If you fast for lawsuits and fights and strike a humble person with fists, why do you fast for Me as today, to make your voice heard in an outcry?
verses.display_text: If you fast for lawsuits and fights and strike a humble person with fists, why do you fast for Me as today, to make your voice heard in an outcry?

verses.text: I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.
verses.display_text: I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.

verses.text: ‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.
verses.display_text: ‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.

verses.text: Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.
verses.display_text: Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.

verses.text: Then your light will break out early, and your healings quickly rise. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and God’s glory will enfold you.
verses.display_text: Then your light will break out early, and your healings quickly rise. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and God’s glory will enfold you.

verses.text: Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking He will say, “Behold, I am present.” If you remove from yourself a bond, finger-pointing, and a word of grumbling,
verses.display_text: Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking He will say, “Behold, I am present.” If you remove from yourself a bond, finger-pointing, and a word of grumbling,

verses.text: and give bread to the hungry from your heart and satisfy a humbled life, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness be like noon.
verses.display_text: and give bread to the hungry from your heart and satisfy a humbled life, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness be like noon.

verses.text: Your God will be with you continually, and you will be filled as your life desires. Your bones will grow rich; you will be like a drenched garden and a spring whose water never ran out. Your bones will sprout like grass and grow rich, and they will inherit generations upon generations.
verses.display_text: Your God will be with you continually, and you will be filled as your life desires. Your bones will grow rich; you will be like a drenched garden and a spring whose water never ran out. Your bones will sprout like grass and grow rich, and they will inherit generations upon generations.

verses.text: Your ancient deserted places will be rebuilt, and your foundations will endure through generations upon generations. You will be called Builder of Fences, and you will put an end to the paths between.
verses.display_text: Your ancient deserted places will be rebuilt, and your foundations will endure through generations upon generations. You will be called Builder of Fences, and you will put an end to the paths between.

verses.text: If you turn your foot away from the Sabbaths, from doing your wishes on the holy day, and call the Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work or speak a word in anger from your mouth,
verses.display_text: If you turn your foot away from the Sabbaths, from doing your wishes on the holy day, and call the Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work or speak a word in anger from your mouth,

verses.text: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”
verses.display_text: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”

verses.text: Is the Lord’s hand unable to save? Or has His ear grown heavy so that He cannot hear?
verses.display_text: Is the Lord’s hand unable to save? Or has His ear grown heavy so that He cannot hear?

verses.text: Instead, your offenses stand between you and God, and because of your sins He has turned His face away from you so as not to show mercy.
verses.display_text: Instead, your offenses stand between you and God, and because of your sins He has turned His face away from you so as not to show mercy.

verses.text: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates on injustice.
verses.display_text: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates on injustice.

verses.text: No one speaks what is just, nor is there true judgment. They trust vain things and speak emptiness, for they conceive trouble and give birth to lawlessness.
verses.display_text: No one speaks what is just, nor is there true judgment. They trust vain things and speak emptiness, for they conceive trouble and give birth to lawlessness.

verses.text: They broke open asps’ eggs and weave a spider’s web. Whoever was about to eat their eggs broke one and found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk.
verses.display_text: They broke open asps’ eggs and weave a spider’s web. Whoever was about to eat their eggs broke one and found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk.

verses.text: Their web will not become clothing, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.
verses.display_text: Their web will not become clothing, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.

verses.text: Their feet run to wickedness, quick to shed blood. Their thoughts are the thoughts of fools; destruction and misery lie in their ways.
verses.display_text: Their feet run to wickedness, quick to shed blood. Their thoughts are the thoughts of fools; destruction and misery lie in their ways.

verses.text: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their ways. For the paths they travel are twisted, and they do not know peace.
verses.display_text: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their ways. For the paths they travel are twisted, and they do not know peace.

verses.text: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.
verses.display_text: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.

verses.text: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.
verses.display_text: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.

verses.text: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.
verses.display_text: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.

verses.text: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:
verses.display_text: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:

verses.text: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.
verses.display_text: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.

verses.text: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.
verses.display_text: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.

verses.text: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.
verses.display_text: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.

verses.text: He saw, and there was no man; He considered, and there was no one to help. He defended them with His arm and steadied Himself by mercy.
verses.display_text: He saw, and there was no man; He considered, and there was no one to help. He defended them with His arm and steadied Himself by mercy.

verses.text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, placed a helmet of salvation on His head, and wrapped Himself in a garment of vengeance and the cloak,
verses.display_text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, placed a helmet of salvation on His head, and wrapped Himself in a garment of vengeance and the cloak,

verses.text: as one who will repay recompense—reproach to His adversaries.
verses.display_text: as one who will repay recompense—reproach to His adversaries.

verses.text: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.
verses.display_text: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.

verses.text: The deliverer will come for Zion’s sake and turn ungodliness away from Jacob.
verses.display_text: The deliverer will come for Zion’s sake and turn ungodliness away from Jacob.

verses.text: “And this is My covenant with them,” said the Lord: “My spirit that is upon you and the words I put into your mouth will never fail from your mouth or your offspring’s mouth,” for the Lord said, “from now on and for ever.”
verses.display_text: “And this is My covenant with them,” said the Lord: “My spirit that is upon you and the words I put into your mouth will never fail from your mouth or your offspring’s mouth,” for the Lord said, “from now on and for ever.”

verses.text: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come, and the Lord’s glory has risen upon you.
verses.display_text: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come, and the Lord’s glory has risen upon you.

verses.text: Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations, but the Lord will appear upon you, and His glory will be seen over you.
verses.display_text: Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations, but the Lord will appear upon you, and His glory will be seen over you.

verses.text: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.
verses.display_text: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.

verses.text: Lift your eyes around you and see your children gathered. Behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.
verses.display_text: Lift your eyes around you and see your children gathered. Behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.

verses.text: Then you will see and fear and be astonished in heart, for the wealth of sea, nations, and peoples will turn toward you. There will come to you
verses.display_text: Then you will see and fear and be astonished in heart, for the wealth of sea, nations, and peoples will turn toward you. There will come to you

verses.text: herds of camels, and camels from Madiam and Gaipha will cover you. They will all come from Saba, bringing gold and carrying frankincense, and they will proclaim the Lord’s salvation as good news.
verses.display_text: herds of camels, and camels from Madiam and Gaipha will cover you. They will all come from Saba, bringing gold and carrying frankincense, and they will proclaim the Lord’s salvation as good news.

verses.text: All Kedar’s sheep will gather to you, and Nabaioth’s rams will come to you. They will be offered acceptably upon My altar, and My house of prayer will be glorified.
verses.display_text: All Kedar’s sheep will gather to you, and Nabaioth’s rams will come to you. They will be offered acceptably upon My altar, and My house of prayer will be glorified.

verses.text: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with their young?
verses.display_text: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with their young?

verses.text: Islands waited for Me, and Tharsis ships among the first, to bring your children from far away, with silver and gold, because of the Lord’s holy name and because Israel’s Holy One is glorious.
verses.display_text: Islands waited for Me, and Tharsis ships among the first, to bring your children from far away, with silver and gold, because of the Lord’s holy name and because Israel’s Holy One is glorious.

verses.text: Foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will attend you. For because of My anger I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.
verses.display_text: Foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will attend you. For because of My anger I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.

verses.text: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring you the nations’ resources and kings being led.
verses.display_text: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring you the nations’ resources and kings being led.

verses.text: For nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolated.
verses.display_text: For nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolated.

verses.text: Lebanon’s glory will come to you in cypress, pine, and cedar together, to glorify My holy place.
verses.display_text: Lebanon’s glory will come to you in cypress, pine, and cedar together, to glorify My holy place.

verses.text: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.
verses.display_text: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.

verses.text: Because you became abandoned and hated, with no one helping, I will make you an everlasting exultation, joy for generations upon generations.
verses.display_text: Because you became abandoned and hated, with no one helping, I will make you an everlasting exultation, joy for generations upon generations.

verses.text: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.
verses.display_text: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.

verses.text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, instead of iron silver, instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. I will appoint your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.
verses.display_text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, instead of iron silver, instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. I will appoint your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.

verses.text: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction and misery within your borders. Your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Engraving.
verses.display_text: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction and misery within your borders. Your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Engraving.

verses.text: The sun will not be your light by day, nor will the rising moon light your night. Instead, the Lord will be your everlasting light and God your glory.
verses.display_text: The sun will not be your light by day, nor will the rising moon light your night. Instead, the Lord will be your everlasting light and God your glory.

verses.text: For your sun will not set, and your moon will not fail. The Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning will be fulfilled.
verses.display_text: For your sun will not set, and your moon will not fail. The Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning will be fulfilled.

verses.text: Your people will all be righteous, and they will inherit the land for ever, guarding the planting, the works of His hands, for glory.
verses.display_text: Your people will all be righteous, and they will inherit the land for ever, guarding the planting, the works of His hands, for glory.

verses.text: The fewest will become thousands, and the least a great nation. I, the Lord, will gather them at the proper time.
verses.display_text: The fewest will become thousands, and the least a great nation. I, the Lord, will gather them at the proper time.

verses.text: The Lord’s spirit is upon me, because He anointed me. He sent me to bring good news to the poor, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to the blind,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s spirit is upon me, because He anointed me. He sent me to bring good news to the poor, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to the blind,

verses.text: to announce the Lord’s acceptable year and a day of recompense, to comfort all who mourn,
verses.display_text: to announce the Lord’s acceptable year and a day of recompense, to comfort all who mourn,

verses.text: so that Zion’s mourners may receive glory instead of ashes, an ointment of joy for those who mourn, a robe of glory instead of a spirit of despondency. They will be called Generations of Righteousness, the Lord’s planting, for glory.
verses.display_text: so that Zion’s mourners may receive glory instead of ashes, an ointment of joy for those who mourn, a robe of glory instead of a spirit of despondency. They will be called Generations of Righteousness, the Lord’s planting, for glory.

verses.text: They will rebuild age-old deserts and raise places formerly desolated. They will renew deserted cities laid waste for generations.
verses.display_text: They will rebuild age-old deserts and raise places formerly desolated. They will renew deserted cities laid waste for generations.

verses.text: Foreigners will come shepherding your sheep, and people of other nations will be plowmen and vinedressers.
verses.display_text: Foreigners will come shepherding your sheep, and people of other nations will be plowmen and vinedressers.

verses.text: But you will be called priests of the Lord, ministers of God. You will consume the nations’ resources and be admired in their wealth.
verses.display_text: But you will be called priests of the Lord, ministers of God. You will consume the nations’ resources and be admired in their wealth.

verses.text: Thus they will inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy will be over their head.
verses.display_text: Thus they will inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy will be over their head.

verses.text: “For I am the Lord who loves righteousness and hates plunder obtained through injustice. I will give their labor’s yield to righteous people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.display_text: “For I am the Lord who loves righteousness and hates plunder obtained through injustice. I will give their labor’s yield to righteous people and make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.text: Their offspring and descendants will be known among nations. Everyone seeing them will recognize them, because they are offspring blessed by God,
verses.display_text: Their offspring and descendants will be known among nations. Everyone seeing them will recognize them, because they are offspring blessed by God,

verses.text: and they will rejoice greatly in the Lord.” Let my soul exult in the Lord, for He clothed me in a garment of salvation and a tunic of joy. Like a bridegroom He placed a turban on me, and like a bride He adorned me with ornaments.
verses.display_text: and they will rejoice greatly in the Lord.” Let my soul exult in the Lord, for He clothed me in a garment of salvation and a tunic of joy. Like a bridegroom He placed a turban on me, and like a bride He adorned me with ornaments.

verses.text: As earth increases its flower and a garden its seeds, so the Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.
verses.display_text: As earth increases its flower and a garden its seeds, so the Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.

verses.text: For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not let up until My righteousness goes out like light and My salvation burns like a torch.
verses.display_text: For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not let up until My righteousness goes out like light and My salvation burns like a torch.

verses.text: Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory. He will call you your new name, which the Lord will name.
verses.display_text: Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory. He will call you your new name, which the Lord will name.

verses.text: You will be a crown of beauty in the Lord’s hand and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
verses.display_text: You will be a crown of beauty in the Lord’s hand and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

verses.text: You will no longer be called Abandoned, nor will your land be called Desert. You will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.
verses.display_text: You will no longer be called Abandoned, nor will your land be called Desert. You will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.

verses.text: As a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you. As a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.
verses.display_text: As a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you. As a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.

verses.text: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed guards all day and all night, who will never be silent as they remember the Lord.
verses.display_text: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed guards all day and all night, who will never be silent as they remember the Lord.

verses.text: For there is no one like you, if He restores Jerusalem and makes her a source of pride upon earth.
verses.display_text: For there is no one like you, if He restores Jerusalem and makes her a source of pride upon earth.

verses.text: The Lord swore by His right hand and the strength of His arm: “I will no longer give your grain and food to your enemies, nor will foreigners drink your wine for which you toiled.
verses.display_text: The Lord swore by His right hand and the strength of His arm: “I will no longer give your grain and food to your enemies, nor will foreigners drink your wine for which you toiled.

verses.text: Instead, those who gather will eat these things and praise the Lord, and those who gather will drink them in My holy dwellings.”
verses.display_text: Instead, those who gather will eat these things and praise the Lord, and those who gather will drink them in My holy dwellings.”

verses.text: Go through My gates and make a road for My people. Scatter the stones from the road; raise a signal for the nations!
verses.display_text: Go through My gates and make a road for My people. Scatter the stones from the road; raise a signal for the nations!

verses.text: For behold, the Lord has made it heard to earth’s farthest end: “Tell daughter Zion, ‘Behold, the savior is arriving for you, bringing His own reward and His work before His face.’”
verses.display_text: For behold, the Lord has made it heard to earth’s farthest end: “Tell daughter Zion, ‘Behold, the savior is arriving for you, bringing His own reward and His work before His face.’”

verses.text: He will call it a holy people redeemed by the Lord; but you will be called a sought-out city, not abandoned.
verses.display_text: He will call it a holy people redeemed by the Lord; but you will be called a sought-out city, not abandoned.

verses.text: Who is this arriving from Edom, with redness of garments from Bosor, so beautiful in His robe, with force and strength? “I speak righteousness and saving judgment.”
verses.display_text: Who is this arriving from Edom, with redness of garments from Bosor, so beautiful in His robe, with force and strength? “I speak righteousness and saving judgment.”

verses.text: Why are Thy garments red and Thy clothes as though from a trodden winepress?
verses.display_text: Why are Thy garments red and Thy clothes as though from a trodden winepress?

verses.text: “I am full of what has been trodden. No man from the nations is with Me. I trampled them in wrath, crushed them like earth, and brought their blood down to earth.
verses.display_text: “I am full of what has been trodden. No man from the nations is with Me. I trampled them in wrath, crushed them like earth, and brought their blood down to earth.

verses.text: For a day of recompense came upon them, and a year of redemption is here.
verses.display_text: For a day of recompense came upon them, and a year of redemption is here.

verses.text: I looked, but there was no helper; I considered, but no one came to aid. My arm rescued them, and My wrath stood by.
verses.display_text: I looked, but there was no helper; I considered, but no one came to aid. My arm rescued them, and My wrath stood by.

verses.text: I trampled them in My anger and brought their blood down to earth.”
verses.display_text: I trampled them in My anger and brought their blood down to earth.”

verses.text: I remembered the Lord’s mercy, the Lord’s excellent deeds in everything He repays us. The Lord is a good judge for Israel’s house; He brings upon us according to His mercy and the abundance of His righteousness.
verses.display_text: I remembered the Lord’s mercy, the Lord’s excellent deeds in everything He repays us. The Lord is a good judge for Israel’s house; He brings upon us according to His mercy and the abundance of His righteousness.

verses.text: He said, “Are they not My people, children who will surely not reject Me?” And He became their salvation
verses.display_text: He said, “Are they not My people, children who will surely not reject Me?” And He became their salvation

verses.text: from every affliction. Neither an envoy nor an angel, but the Lord Himself saved them because He loved and spared them. He Himself redeemed them, took them up, and exalted them throughout all the days of the age.
verses.display_text: from every affliction. Neither an envoy nor an angel, but the Lord Himself saved them because He loved and spared them. He Himself redeemed them, took them up, and exalted them throughout all the days of the age.

verses.text: But they disobeyed and provoked His holy spirit. He turned toward hostility against them and Himself fought them.
verses.display_text: But they disobeyed and provoked His holy spirit. He turned toward hostility against them and Himself fought them.

verses.text: The one who brought the sheep’s shepherd up from earth remembered days of old. Where is the one who placed the holy spirit among them,
verses.display_text: The one who brought the sheep’s shepherd up from earth remembered days of old. Where is the one who placed the holy spirit among them,

verses.text: who led Moses by the right hand, the arm of His glory? He overpowered water before Him to make Himself an everlasting name.
verses.display_text: who led Moses by the right hand, the arm of His glory? He overpowered water before Him to make Himself an everlasting name.

verses.text: He led them through the abyss like a horse through a wilderness, and they did not grow weary.
verses.display_text: He led them through the abyss like a horse through a wilderness, and they did not grow weary.

verses.text: Like livestock through a plain, a spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So Thou didst lead Thy people to make Thyself a glorious name.
verses.display_text: Like livestock through a plain, a spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So Thou didst lead Thy people to make Thyself a glorious name.

verses.text: Turn from heaven and see from Thy holy and glorious house. Where are Thy zeal and strength? Where is the abundance of Thy mercy and compassion, since Thou hast held back from us?
verses.display_text: Turn from heaven and see from Thy holy and glorious house. Where are Thy zeal and strength? Where is the abundance of Thy mercy and compassion, since Thou hast held back from us?

verses.text: For Thou art our Father, because Abraham did not know us and Israel did not recognize us. But Thou, Lord, art our Father. Rescue us! From the beginning Thy name has been upon us.
verses.display_text: For Thou art our Father, because Abraham did not know us and Israel did not recognize us. But Thou, Lord, art our Father. Rescue us! From the beginning Thy name has been upon us.

verses.text: Why, Lord, didst Thou make us stray from Thy way and harden our hearts so that we do not fear Thee? Return because of Thy servants, because of the tribes of Thine inheritance,
verses.display_text: Why, Lord, didst Thou make us stray from Thy way and harden our hearts so that we do not fear Thee? Return because of Thy servants, because of the tribes of Thine inheritance,

verses.text: so that we may inherit a little of Thy holy mountain. Our adversaries trampled Thy sanctuary.
verses.display_text: so that we may inherit a little of Thy holy mountain. Our adversaries trampled Thy sanctuary.

verses.text: We became as at the beginning, when Thou didst not rule us and Thy name had not been called upon us. If Thou openest heaven, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee, and they will melt,
verses.display_text: We became as at the beginning, when Thou didst not rule us and Thy name had not been called upon us. If Thou openest heaven, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee, and they will melt,

verses.text: like wax melting before fire. Fire will burn up the adversaries, and the Lord’s name will become manifest among the adversaries. Nations will be shaken before Thee.
verses.display_text: like wax melting before fire. Fire will burn up the adversaries, and the Lord’s name will become manifest among the adversaries. Nations will be shaken before Thee.

verses.text: Whenever Thou dost glorious things, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee.
verses.display_text: Whenever Thou dost glorious things, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee.

verses.text: From of old we have not heard, nor have our eyes seen a god except Thee and Thy works, which Thou wilt do for those awaiting mercy.
verses.display_text: From of old we have not heard, nor have our eyes seen a god except Thee and Thy works, which Thou wilt do for those awaiting mercy.

verses.text: For He will meet those doing what is just, and they will remember Thy ways. Behold, Thou becamest angry, and we sinned; therefore we went astray.
verses.display_text: For He will meet those doing what is just, and they will remember Thy ways. Behold, Thou becamest angry, and we sinned; therefore we went astray.

verses.text: We all became like unclean people; all our righteousness is like a menstruating woman’s rag. We fell away like leaves because of our lawless deeds; thus wind will carry us off.
verses.display_text: We all became like unclean people; all our righteousness is like a menstruating woman’s rag. We fell away like leaves because of our lawless deeds; thus wind will carry us off.

verses.text: There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.
verses.display_text: There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.

verses.text: But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.
verses.display_text: But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.

verses.text: Do not be exceedingly angry with us or remember our sins at the appointed time. And now look, for we are all Thy people.
verses.display_text: Do not be exceedingly angry with us or remember our sins at the appointed time. And now look, for we are all Thy people.

verses.text: The city of Thy holy place became a desert; Zion became like a desert, Jerusalem a curse.
verses.display_text: The city of Thy holy place became a desert; Zion became like a desert, Jerusalem a curse.

verses.text: The house, our holy place, and the glory our ancestors blessed became fire-burned, and all the glorious things collapsed.
verses.display_text: The house, our holy place, and the glory our ancestors blessed became fire-burned, and all the glorious things collapsed.

verses.text: Despite all these things Thou didst hold back, Lord, and keep silent and humble us greatly.
verses.display_text: Despite all these things Thou didst hold back, Lord, and keep silent and humble us greatly.

verses.text: “I became manifest to those not seeking Me; I was found by those not inquiring of Me. I said, ‘Here I am,’ to the nation that did not call My name.
verses.display_text: “I became manifest to those not seeking Me; I was found by those not inquiring of Me. I said, ‘Here I am,’ to the nation that did not call My name.

verses.text: I spread out My hands all day to a disobedient, contradicting people who did not walk in a true way but followed their sins.
verses.display_text: I spread out My hands all day to a disobedient, contradicting people who did not walk in a true way but followed their sins.

verses.text: This people continually provokes Me to My face. They sacrifice in gardens and burn incense on bricks to demons that do not exist,
verses.display_text: This people continually provokes Me to My face. They sacrifice in gardens and burn incense on bricks to demons that do not exist,

verses.text: and sleep in tombs and caves for dreams. They eat pig’s flesh and sacrificial broth; all their vessels are defiled.
verses.display_text: and sleep in tombs and caves for dreams. They eat pig’s flesh and sacrificial broth; all their vessels are defiled.

verses.text: They say, ‘Far away from me! Do not approach me, for I am clean.’ This is smoke of My wrath; fire burns in it all the days.
verses.display_text: They say, ‘Far away from me! Do not approach me, for I am clean.’ This is smoke of My wrath; fire burns in it all the days.

verses.text: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent until I repay into their lap
verses.display_text: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent until I repay into their lap

verses.text: their sins and their ancestors’ sins,” says the Lord, “who burned incense on mountains and insulted Me on hills. I will repay their works into their lap.”
verses.display_text: their sins and their ancestors’ sins,” says the Lord, “who burned incense on mountains and insulted Me on hills. I will repay their works into their lap.”

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “As a grape is found in the cluster and people say, ‘Do not ruin it, for the Lord’s blessing is in it,’ so I will act for the sake of the one serving Me; for this one’s sake I will not destroy everyone.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “As a grape is found in the cluster and people say, ‘Do not ruin it, for the Lord’s blessing is in it,’ so I will act for the sake of the one serving Me; for this one’s sake I will not destroy everyone.

verses.text: I will bring out the offspring from Jacob and from Judah, and it will inherit My holy mountain. My chosen ones and My slaves will inherit and dwell there.
verses.display_text: I will bring out the offspring from Jacob and from Judah, and it will inherit My holy mountain. My chosen ones and My slaves will inherit and dwell there.

verses.text: There will be shelters for flocks in the woodland, and the ravine of Achor will be a resting place for cattle, for My people who sought Me.
verses.display_text: There will be shelters for flocks in the woodland, and the ravine of Achor will be a resting place for cattle, for My people who sought Me.

verses.text: But you who abandoned Me and forget My holy mountain, preparing a table for the demon and filling a mixed drink for Fortune,
verses.display_text: But you who abandoned Me and forget My holy mountain, preparing a table for the demon and filling a mixed drink for Fortune,

verses.text: I will hand you over to the sword; all of you will fall in slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey, I spoke and you disregarded Me. You did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”
verses.display_text: I will hand you over to the sword; all of you will fall in slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey, I spoke and you disregarded Me. You did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: “Behold, those serving Me will eat, but you will hunger. Those serving Me will drink, but you will thirst. Those serving Me will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: “Behold, those serving Me will eat, but you will hunger. Those serving Me will drink, but you will thirst. Those serving Me will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.

verses.text: Behold, those serving Me will exult with joy, but you will cry out because of your heart’s pain and wail from a broken spirit.
verses.display_text: Behold, those serving Me will exult with joy, but you will cry out because of your heart’s pain and wail from a broken spirit.

verses.text: For you will leave your name as a surfeit for My chosen ones, but the Lord will put you to death. Those serving Him will be called a new name,
verses.display_text: For you will leave your name as a surfeit for My chosen ones, but the Lord will put you to death. Those serving Him will be called a new name,

verses.text: which will be blessed upon earth. For they will bless the true God, and those swearing upon earth will swear by the true God. They will forget their former affliction, and it will not rise into their heart.
verses.display_text: which will be blessed upon earth. For they will bless the true God, and those swearing upon earth will swear by the true God. They will forget their former affliction, and it will not rise into their heart.

verses.text: For heaven will be new and earth new, and they will never remember former things, nor will those things enter their heart,
verses.display_text: For heaven will be new and earth new, and they will never remember former things, nor will those things enter their heart,

verses.text: but they will find joy and exultation in it. For behold, I am making Jerusalem an exultation and My people joy.
verses.display_text: but they will find joy and exultation in it. For behold, I am making Jerusalem an exultation and My people joy.

verses.text: I will exult over Jerusalem and rejoice over My people, and no sound of weeping or crying will ever again be heard in her.
verses.display_text: I will exult over Jerusalem and rejoice over My people, and no sound of weeping or crying will ever again be heard in her.

verses.text: There will never be one cut off prematurely there, nor an old man who fails to complete his time. For the young person will be a hundred years old, but the sinner who dies will be a hundred years old and accursed.
verses.display_text: There will never be one cut off prematurely there, nor an old man who fails to complete his time. For the young person will be a hundred years old, but the sinner who dies will be a hundred years old and accursed.

verses.text: They will build houses and inhabit them themselves; they will plant vineyards and eat their own produce.
verses.display_text: They will build houses and inhabit them themselves; they will plant vineyards and eat their own produce.

verses.text: They will not build for others to inhabit or plant for others to eat. For My people’s days will be like those of the tree of life; they will wear out the works of their labor.
verses.display_text: They will not build for others to inhabit or plant for others to eat. For My people’s days will be like those of the tree of life; they will wear out the works of their labor.

verses.text: My chosen ones will not labor in vain or bear children for a curse, because they are offspring blessed by God, and their descendants will be with them.
verses.display_text: My chosen ones will not labor in vain or bear children for a curse, because they are offspring blessed by God, and their descendants will be with them.

verses.text: Before they cry out I will listen to them; while they are still speaking I will say, ‘What is it?’
verses.display_text: Before they cry out I will listen to them; while they are still speaking I will say, ‘What is it?’

verses.text: Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and a lion will eat straw like an ox, while a serpent will eat earth like bread. They will not wrong or destroy on My holy mountain,” says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and a lion will eat straw like an ox, while a serpent will eat earth like bread. They will not wrong or destroy on My holy mountain,” says the Lord.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: “Heaven is My throne, and earth the footstool of My feet. What sort of house will you build for Me, or what place is My rest?
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: “Heaven is My throne, and earth the footstool of My feet. What sort of house will you build for Me, or what place is My rest?

verses.text: For My hand made all these things, and all these things are Mine,” says the Lord. “And to whom will I look except the humble and quiet one who trembles at My words?
verses.display_text: For My hand made all these things, and all these things are Mine,” says the Lord. “And to whom will I look except the humble and quiet one who trembles at My words?

verses.text: But the lawless person who sacrifices a calf to Me is like someone killing a dog; the one offering fine flour is like one offering pig’s blood; the one giving frankincense as a memorial is like a blasphemer. These people chose their ways and their abominations, which their soul desired,
verses.display_text: But the lawless person who sacrifices a calf to Me is like someone killing a dog; the one offering fine flour is like one offering pig’s blood; the one giving frankincense as a memorial is like a blasphemer. These people chose their ways and their abominations, which their soul desired,

verses.text: and I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey Me, I spoke and they did not hear. They did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”
verses.display_text: and I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey Me, I spoke and they did not hear. They did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”

verses.text: Hear the Lord’s word, you who tremble at His word! Speak, our brothers, to those who hate us and loathe us, so that the Lord’s name may be glorified and seen in their rejoicing; and those people will be ashamed.
verses.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word, you who tremble at His word! Speak, our brothers, to those who hate us and loathe us, so that the Lord’s name may be glorified and seen in their rejoicing; and those people will be ashamed.

verses.text: A sound of shouting from the city, a sound from the temple, the sound of the Lord repaying recompense to His opponents!
verses.display_text: A sound of shouting from the city, a sound from the temple, the sound of the Lord repaying recompense to His opponents!

verses.text: Before the woman in labor gave birth, before the pain of labor came, she escaped and bore a male.
verses.display_text: Before the woman in labor gave birth, before the pain of labor came, she escaped and bore a male.

verses.text: Who heard such a thing, and who has seen anything like it? Did a land labor in one day, or was a nation born all at once? For Zion labored and bore her children.
verses.display_text: Who heard such a thing, and who has seen anything like it? Did a land labor in one day, or was a nation born all at once? For Zion labored and bore her children.

verses.text: ‘But I gave this expectation, and you did not remember Me,’ said the Lord. ‘Behold, did I not make the woman who gives birth and the barren woman?’ said God.
verses.display_text: ‘But I gave this expectation, and you did not remember Me,’ said the Lord. ‘Behold, did I not make the woman who gives birth and the barren woman?’ said God.

verses.text: Rejoice, Jerusalem, and celebrate in her, all who love her! Rejoice with joy, all who mourn over her,
verses.display_text: Rejoice, Jerusalem, and celebrate in her, all who love her! Rejoice with joy, all who mourn over her,

verses.text: so that you may nurse and be filled from her comforting breast, so that, nursing fully, you may delight in the entrance of her glory.
verses.display_text: so that you may nurse and be filled from her comforting breast, so that, nursing fully, you may delight in the entrance of her glory.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I turn toward them like a river of peace, and like a flooding torrent the glory of nations. Their children will be lifted on shoulders and comforted on knees.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I turn toward them like a river of peace, and like a flooding torrent the glory of nations. Their children will be lifted on shoulders and comforted on knees.

verses.text: As if a mother were to comfort someone, so I too will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.’
verses.display_text: As if a mother were to comfort someone, so I too will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.’

verses.text: You will see, and your heart will rejoice; your bones will spring up like vegetation. The Lord’s hand will be known to those who revere Him, and He will threaten the disobedient.
verses.display_text: You will see, and your heart will rejoice; your bones will spring up like vegetation. The Lord’s hand will be known to those who revere Him, and He will threaten the disobedient.

verses.text: For behold, the Lord will come like fire, and His chariots like a storm, to render vengeance in wrath and rejection in a flame of fire.
verses.display_text: For behold, the Lord will come like fire, and His chariots like a storm, to render vengeance in wrath and rejection in a flame of fire.

verses.text: For by the Lord’s fire all the earth will be judged, and by His sword all flesh; many will be wounded by the Lord.
verses.display_text: For by the Lord’s fire all the earth will be judged, and by His sword all flesh; many will be wounded by the Lord.

verses.text: ‘Those purifying and cleansing themselves for the gardens, eating pig’s flesh and abominations and the mouse in the porches, will be consumed together,’ said the Lord,
verses.display_text: ‘Those purifying and cleansing themselves for the gardens, eating pig’s flesh and abominations and the mouse in the porches, will be consumed together,’ said the Lord,

verses.text: ‘and I know their works and their reasoning. I am coming to gather all nations and languages, and they will come and see My glory.
verses.display_text: ‘and I know their works and their reasoning. I am coming to gather all nations and languages, and they will come and see My glory.

verses.text: I will leave signs upon them and send those saved from them to the nations: to Tharsis, Phoud, Loud, Mosoch, Thobel and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard My name or seen My glory. They will announce My glory among the nations.
verses.display_text: I will leave signs upon them and send those saved from them to the nations: to Tharsis, Phoud, Loud, Mosoch, Thobel and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard My name or seen My glory. They will announce My glory among the nations.

verses.text: They will bring your brothers from all nations as a gift to the Lord, with horses and chariots, in mule carriages with sunshades, to the holy city Jerusalem,’ said the Lord, ‘as the Israelites might bring Me their sacrifices with psalms into the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: They will bring your brothers from all nations as a gift to the Lord, with horses and chariots, in mule carriages with sunshades, to the holy city Jerusalem,’ said the Lord, ‘as the Israelites might bring Me their sacrifices with psalms into the Lord’s house.

verses.text: From them I will take priests and Levites for Myself,’ said the Lord.
verses.display_text: From them I will take priests and Levites for Myself,’ said the Lord.

verses.text: ‘For just as the new heaven and new earth that I make remain before Me,’ says the Lord, ‘so your offspring and your name will stand.
verses.display_text: ‘For just as the new heaven and new earth that I make remain before Me,’ says the Lord, ‘so your offspring and your name will stand.

verses.text: Month after month and Sabbath after Sabbath, all flesh will come before Me to bow down in Jerusalem,’ said the Lord.
verses.display_text: Month after month and Sabbath after Sabbath, all flesh will come before Me to bow down in Jerusalem,’ said the Lord.

verses.text: ‘They will go out and see the limbs of the people who transgressed against Me, for their worm will not die and their fire will not be quenched. They will be a spectacle to all flesh.’
verses.display_text: ‘They will go out and see the limbs of the people who transgressed against Me, for their worm will not die and their fire will not be quenched. They will be a spectacle to all flesh.’
